# Competitor page background / atmosphere audit

**Date:** 2026-09-03  
**Question:** What gradient style and opacity do Tier A/B Amazon agencies use for light page atmosphere?  
**Method:** Playwright live CSS + SVG source + prior hero screenshots

---

## Evidence

| Source | Finding | Confidence |
|--------|---------|------------|
| Canopy `Gradient-Accent.svg` | Ellipse radial `#DAFF5B` → white transparent, **fill-opacity 0.2** | High |
| Canopy `Gradient-Accent-Tech.svg` | Same radial, **fill-opacity 0.15** | High |
| Canopy hero banner | Single localized SVG blob (`background-size: 888px`, not full-bleed wash) | High |
| Olifant Digital | Soft pastel solids: body `#FFFEF9`, hero `#FEF5DA`, sage `#F1F9E9` linear fades — low chroma, no strong orbs | High |
| Sequence Commerce | Dark cinematic hero radial (skip for our light brand) | High |
| MAG hero screenshot | Near-white base; very faint neutral glow behind visual (~5–10% perceived) | Medium |

## Conclusion

Premium light competitors use **one soft localized blob at ~15–20% opacity**, or pastel solid washes — not multi-color high-opacity global orbs.

## Our change (Applied)

| Layer | Before | After (competitor-matched) |
|-------|--------|----------------------------|
| Wash cyan | color-mix 26% | **12%** |
| Wash accent | 22% | **10%** |
| Wash navy | 12% | **6%** |
| Base falloff | to `#EEF2F6` | to `#F7F8FA` (lighter) |
| Orbs | 4 at /30 /28 /14 /22 | **3** at ~0.12 / 0.10 / 0.07 + blur 90–100px |

Brand colors kept (cyan / accent / navy). Cream Olifant palette not copied (design rule: avoid cream+terracotta AI cliché).

## Uncertainty

Perceived opacity depends on monitor and section surface fills. User visual review required at localhost.

# Competitor global content max-width

**Date:** 2026-09-03  
**Method:** Playwright computed `max-width` on above-the-fold / primary containers (viewport 1440px)  
**Confidence:** High for measured CSS max-width; Medium for “primary” container choice when multiple exist

## Results (Verified)

| Site | Primary global / shell max-width | Also seen |
|------|----------------------------------|-----------|
| Canopy Management | **1400px** (`.container`) | 1200px inner, 1112px header strip |
| Olifant Digital | **1320px** (`.navbar_container`) | 960px hero text |
| AMZ Dudes | **1320px** (row / shell) | **1280px** top bar inner; 1180px padded content |
| My Amazon Guy | **1290px** (Elementor container) | — |
| Sequence Commerce | *(pending in this pass — see note)* | — |

## Pattern

Industry mid/premium Amazon agencies cluster around **1280–1400px** for the main content shell.

| Too narrow | Typical | Too wide for text shell |
|------------|---------|-------------------------|
| ≤1024px (`max-w-5xl`) | **1280–1320px** | Full 1920px content column |

**1920px** is a viewport/canvas width, not the usual *content* max-width. Competitors keep readable line lengths by capping the shell ~1300–1400px while allowing full-bleed backgrounds.

## Implication for eCom Gliders

Current `container-page` at **1920px** is wider than every measured competitor shell.  
Recommended align: **1320px** or **1280px** (AMZ Dudes / Olifant band), optionally **1400px** if matching Canopy’s widest shell.

input.plan:
# Homepage Landing Page Audit and Blueprint

**Evidence date:** 2026-09-03  
**Sources:** [`content/config/homepage.json`](content/config/homepage.json), section components under [`src/components/sections/`](src/components/sections/), [`backup/pages/homepage.html`](backup/pages/homepage.html), Playwright live pass on https://ecomgliders.com/, competitor docs in [`docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md`](docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md) + live AMZ Dudes headings, prior hero audit [`docs/research/HERO-COMPETITOR-UI-AUDIT-2026-09-03.md`](docs/research/HERO-COMPETITOR-UI-AUDIT-2026-09-03.md).

**Verdict:** Current home has a solid **conversion skeleton** (12 wired sections + lead form), but it is **proof-thin and image-poor** compared to the old Elementor homepage and vs AMZ Dudes / Olifant / Canopy. Old site wins on logos, creative gallery, values story, review badges, and featured press. New site wins on structure, SEO/FAQ depth, comparison table, and cleaner IA. Target: keep new IA spine, **reintroduce old-site proof layers with professional copy**, migrate assets from [`backup/assets/images/uploads/`](backup/assets/images/uploads/).

---

## 1. Current homepage code (Verified)

**Wiring:** `page.tsx` → `getHomepage()` → `HomepageSectionRenderer` → 12 enabled sections from [`homepage.json`](content/config/homepage.json).

| # | Section | Status |
|---|---------|--------|
| 1 | Hero + lead form | Polished conversion path; form compact pass done; `deferredVisual` BrowserMockup unused |
| 2 | Trust bar | Only 3 partner marks; Amazon badge duplicated with hero |
| 3 | Stats | 4 honest metrics OK |
| 4 | Services | 6 cards, one-line copy, Lucide only |
| 5 | Seller segments | 3 text cards, no CTAs |
| 6 | Case studies | 3 metric cards, **no images** |
| 7 | Process | 4 steps, text only |
| 8 | Comparison | Strong AEO table |
| 9 | Testimonials | 5 named quotes; config notes 6th still needed |
| 10 | Blog preview | 3 posts, **no featured images** |
| 11 | FAQ | 10 solid Q&As + JSON-LD |
| 12 | Final CTA | Audit + phone + email |

**Gaps vs conversion agency LPs:** almost no photography/creative proof; no client logo wall; no review platform badges; no mid-page visual proof (mockup deferred); thin service/segment depth; no press row.

**Assets live in `public/images` today:** logo, Amazon Verified Partner, eLEEVATE, SSP, AI SVGs. Client logos, GoSports art, Trustpilot/Google badges, press marks, creative samples exist in **backup uploads** but are not production-wired.

---

## 2. Old site homepage (Observed from backup + live)

**Live title:** Amazon PPC Agency – SEO & Account Management | eCom Gliders  
**Stack:** WordPress + Elementor (heavy plugin CSS; not to rebuild).

**Section flow (content order):**

1. **Hero** — H1 PPC-focused (“High-Converting PPC Ads…”), Free Audit CTAs, large Amazon FBA imagery  
2. **Client logos** — “OUR Clients / Trusted by” marquee (`2-1`…`10.png`, etc.)  
3. **Featured result** — GoSports **310%** sales increase spotlight  
4. **Creative showcase** — “Get Amazon creative…” product/listing creative gallery  
5. **Brand values** — “We’re Real…” + 4 pillars (Strategic Brand Engineering, Immersive Client Collaboration, Momentum-Focused Systems, Integrity-Led Execution)  
6. **Services block** — “Pro-level Amazon Account Management Services”  
7. **Testimonials** — named quotes + Trustpilot / Google review badges  
8. **Stats** — $112M+ / 95% / 20+ / since 2018  
9. **Onboarding** — “Onboarding That Gets You Selling Faster…”  
10. **Mid CTA** — “Turn Potential Into Profit…” / Book a call  
11. **Featured in** — DesignRush, JBMS360, News Break, Vents Magazine  
12. **Why us / FAQ accordion** — deep answers (marketplaces US/UK/CA/EU, PPC process, creative, pricing models, 4-step start)  
13. **Newsletter** — subscribe block  
14. **Footer partner strip** — “A partner, not a vendor” + services links  

**Old-site KEEP (content/assets):** client logos; GoSports 310% story art; creative gallery frames; Trustpilot + Google badge images; press logos; FAQ depth (especially marketplaces + get-started steps); verified metrics.

**Old-site IMPROVE (copy):** rewrite AI-ish / unprofessional lines per rule 13 (`Seller Hacks`, “We’re Real…”, vague creative H2). Prefer current professional H1/meta over old PPC-only H1 for account-management positioning.

**Old-site REMOVE:** Elementor bloat, inactive heading noise, emoji/Unicode UI, newsletter until ESP is confirmed and wired (exclude from this homepage build).

---

## 3. Competitor patterns (Adopt / Skip)

| Pattern | MAG / Canopy / Olifant | AMZ Dudes (live) | eCom Gliders target |
|---------|------------------------|------------------|---------------------|
| Hero | Proof visual / people | Form + growth audit | **Keep form-in-hero** (already shipped) |
| Trust under hero | Logo density + reviews | Satisfied clients | **Client logos + review badges** |
| Stats | Dense | “Proof in real numbers” | Keep 4 honest stats |
| Services | Pillars / numbered | Full roof grid | Deeper 6-card grid |
| Creative proof | Cases / galleries | Creative that converts | **Restore creative strip** |
| Cases | Metric + visual | Screenshot/results | **Cases with images** |
| Process | 3–4 steps | Growth strategy CTA | Process + old onboarding steps |
| Comparison | Sequence-style | — | Keep |
| FAQ | Deep + schema | Long FAQ | Keep + merge best old answers |
| Skip | Dark cinematic, fake #1, office spam, metric inflation | Emoji UI, claim inflation | Skip |

**Differentiation (locked):** in-house specialists, 95% retention, Amazon Ads Verified Partner, blog moat, GoSports 310% — not enterprise scale or proprietary software.

---

## 4. Locked target landing IA (14 sections)

Replace thin proof with old-site strengths; do not rebuild Elementor layout.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  hero[1_Hero_LeadForm]
  trust[2_Trust_Clients_Reviews]
  stats[3_Stats]
  services[4_Services_Deep]
  creative[5_Creative_Showcase]
  segments[6_Seller_Segments]
  cases[7_Case_Studies_Visual]
  values[8_Brand_Values]
  process[9_Process_Onboarding]
  compare[10_Comparison]
  testimonials[11_Testimonials]
  blog[12_Blog_Preview]
  faq[13_FAQ]
  cta[14_Final_CTA]
  hero --> trust --> stats --> services --> creative --> segments --> cases --> values --> process --> compare --> testimonials --> blog --> faq --> cta
```

| # | Section | Action | Detail |
|---|---------|--------|--------|
| 1 | Hero | KEEP + polish | Lead form stays. Partner badge + dual CTA. No BrowserMockup in hero. |

### Research

#### Current code (Verified)

- Component: [`trust-bar-section.tsx`](src/components/sections/trust-bar-section.tsx) + [`trust-logo.tsx`](src/components/sections/trust-logo.tsx)

- Logos today: eLEEVATE, **Amazon Verified Partner (duplicate of hero)**, SSP
- `TrustLogo` UI: bordered `h-16` tile, lazy image, fallback `Badge` on error; optional external `Link`
- Tone: `SectionShell` `muted`, `py-8 sm:py-10`
- **Gap:** no client brand logos, no review badges, no press row; Amazon badge repeated; `statLine` overlaps Stats section metrics

#### Old site (Observed — backup HTML)

| Block | Copy / assets |
|-------|----------------|
| Client logos | Eyebrow “OUR Clients”; “Our work speaks for itself Trusted by:”; **10 logos**: `1st-brand.png`, `2-1`…`8-1`, `9.png`, `10.png` under `uploads/2025/04/` — all files **Verified present** in backup (3–18 KB each) |
| Review badges | Near testimonials: `Trustpilot-1.png`, `Google-reviews2webp.webp` (`uploads/2025/03/` + wp-media copies) |
| Featured in | DesignRush, JBMS360, News Break, Vents Magazine PNGs under `uploads/2025/09/` / wp-media |
| Partner marks | eLEEVATE, Verified Partner, SSP also appear elsewhere on old home |

**Alt text debt (Observed):** client logos mostly alt=`best amazon fba agency eCom Gliders` — unusable for a11y/SEO. New alts must be brand names once identified, or neutral “Client brand logo N” until names confirmed.

**Review links:** no `trustpilot.com` / Google Maps profile URLs found in homepage HTML. DesignRush profile **Observed:** `https://www.designrush.com/agency/profile/ecom-gliders`.

**AI logos in Featured region:** ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity/Gemini appear on old home near press — **do not** put in trust bar (already handled by announcement bar).

#### Competitors (Observed)

| Source | Pattern | Adopt | Skip |
|--------|---------|-------|------|
| MAG (live 2026-09-03) | “Trusted by major brands…” + dense grayscale client logo strip under hero | Client logo density + muted treatment | Claiming “major brands” without matching roster |
| Sequence / Design-Inspiration | Review scores + trust density | Review badge row | Fake Clutch score we do not have verified |

# Homepage visual audit (post Waves A–F)

**Date:** 2026-09-03  
**Method:** Playwright section screenshots at 1440×900 on `http://localhost:3000/`  
**Evidence:** `docs/qa/screenshots/audit-00-fold.png` + `audit-01-*.png` … `audit-14-*.png`

## Verdict

User concern is **fair**. The homepage now has a solid conversion IA and professional copy, but visually it still reads as **text + thin cards + sparse proof**. Old Elementor home and competitors (Canopy / AMZ Dudes / MAG) win on photography, multi-image creative, and metric-on-visual density. New site wins on structure, form, FAQ/schema, comparison — not on “catchiness.”

Confidence: **High** (Observed in screenshots).

## Per-section scorecard

| # | Section | Visual density | Observed | Gap vs old/competitors | Priority |
|---|---------|----------------|----------|------------------------|----------|
| 1 | Hero | Medium | Form-first split; soft atmosphere; partner badge | No people/product hero art; competitors use face + metrics or richer form chrome | P1 |
| 2 | Trust | Medium | Partners + grayscale marquee + badges | Logos too faint (opacity/grayscale); feels empty in user’s browser crop | P1 |
| 3 | Stats | Low | Numbers only, no charts/icons | Competitors often glue metric devices / bars under hero | P2 |
| 4 | Services | Low | Lucide icons + text cards | No service imagery; “flat SaaS grid” | P1 |
| 5 | Creative | Medium–High | **One** Les Plaisirs still | Subhead promises infographics/A+ but gallery is 1 tile; old site had more frames + video | P0 |
| 6 | Segments | Low | Icon cards + CTAs | No stage visuals | P2 |
| 7 | Cases | Medium | Logos + orange metrics | Logo-mark treatment, not result charts / before-after | P1 |
| 8 | Values | Low | Icon + copy pillars | Correctly de-sloganized; visually quiet | P2 |
| 9 | Process | High | Steps + assurances + **BrowserMockup chart** | This is the strongest “infographic” block — under-noticed if user stops at trust | Keep / feature earlier? |
| 10 | Comparison | Low | Table only | Fine for AEO; not visual | OK |
| 11 | Testimonials | Low | Quote cards, no photos | No avatars (by plan); feels text-wall | P2 |
| 12 | Blog | Low | Text-only (ChatGPT thumbs skipped) | Competitors show thumbs | P1 when QA art ready |
| 13 | FAQ | Low | Accordion | OK functional | OK |
| 14 | Final CTA | Medium | Navy band | Clean; no supporting visual | P3 |

## Root causes (not “forgot sections”)

1. **Plan deliberately avoided** Elementor collage, emoji, dark cinematic hero, awards-wall spam.
2. **Creative gallery seeded with 1 still** (C2: QA-only; Vimeo deferred).
3. **Blog thumbs skipped** (AI stock rejected).
4. **Client logos grayscale + low opacity** make trust look “empty” even though assets exist.
5. **Services/segments/values** are icon+copy by lock — competitors use photography or illustrated process.

## Proposed visual polish wave (requires your go-ahead)

Do **not** invent fake metrics. Prefer real assets from backup + process mockup pattern.

1. **Trust** — raise client logo opacity; less aggressive grayscale; slightly larger marks.
2. **Creative** — add 2–4 more QA-passed listing/A+ stills (infographic-style frames if available in backup).
3. **Services** — optional small illustration or muted background motif per card (or one shared capability strip), not stock random photos.
4. **Cases** — prefer result chart / listing screenshot over logo-only where backup has authentic art.
5. **Stats** — light sparkline / divider treatment so numbers don’t float as plain text.
6. Optional: move a **compact proof strip** (mockup crop or creative thumbs) closer under stats so mid-page isn’t all text cards.

## Out of scope unless approved

- Dark hero rebuild  
- Fake infographics / unverified % overlays  
- Restoring unprofessional old slogans  
- Newsletter / WhatsApp / exit-intent  

## Next action

Confirm if you want a **Visual polish wave** starting with Trust + Creative density (highest ROI), then Services/Cases.

# Crazy Galaxy Button Hover Animation in Framer

This is an out-of-this-world button component for [Framer](../free-account), bringing [Alex Barashkov's](https://x.com/alex_barashkov/status/1833509059619643638) galaxy hover animation to life. With its mesmerizing glow and swirling particles, it's sure to make your friends go "wow." The best part? You can easily add this impressive interaction to your site without writing any code.

Created by

[Nandi](https://x.com/nandimuzsik)

and

[Alex](https://x.com/alex_barashkov)

Related Lesson

Raw Process of Recreating a Crazy Hover Effect

Watch the video

## [About the resource](#about-the-resource)

When creating these complex glowing graphics on websites, I usually use a bunch of drop shadows on elements to achieve the effect. When you combine these shadows with gradient fill colors, you can get some pretty amazing results.

Outer glow drop shadow layers.

You can see in this little video above, for example, how the outer glow effect of the button is built up with 3 separate drop shadows on the same element. Feel free to remix the project, by the way, to dig into each of the layers and their drop shadow settings.

The great thing about these drop shadows is that we can also animate them when we finally turn the button into a component and create multiple variants for it for the hover animation. We just tweak the opacity, y, blur, or spread values, and they'll all be nicely animated.

### [The particles component](#the-particles-component)

Another notable element on this specific galaxy button is the particles effect that appears as we hover over the button. You can see how the particles move toward the bottom center of the button.

I achieved that effect with the particles component (created by [Benjamin](https://x.com/benjaminnathan)). You can [get that component here](./particles-component-for-framer).

The particles component in Framer.

The good thing about that particles component is that it's highly customizable. I could tweak it to get it super close to what we see on the original button concept.

I also did a trick: duplicated the particles component to have 3 in total and set different size, speed, and opacity properties on each of them. This resulted in a more complex and overall better-looking effect.

>

Quick tip: when you duplicate the particles component and you're using multiple on one page, make sure that each has a unique "ID" property set on the left panel (otherwise they're not gonna work).

# Stats section — research-backed polish plan

## Scope lock

**Next section after finalized Hero + Trust:** Stats (`id: stats`, type `stats`) — [homepage.json](content/config/homepage.json) order 3 of 14.

**Do not change:** the four verified company claims, placement after Trust, or add count-up / ticker / fifth vanity metric.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  hero[1_Hero]
  trust[2_Trust]
  stats[3_Stats]
  services[4_Services]
  hero --> trust --> stats --> services
```

## Research summary (evidence)

| Source | Finding | Adopt |
|--------|---------|-------|
| [B3 LOCKED](.cursor/plans/homepage_landing_audit_0b7e065e.plan.md) | Proof strip under trust; 4 honest metrics; no heading preferred | Keep decisions |
| [stats-section.tsx](src/components/sections/stats-section.tsx) | Still **card-heavy**: `border` + `shadow-sm` + top accent bar + orange value | Soften to quieter cells |
| [trust-bar-section.tsx](src/components/sections/trust-bar-section.tsx) | Logo/marquee density, compact `py-6/8` | Stats needs calm contrast after dense trust |
| AMZ Dudes ([COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md](docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md)) | Early large numbers | Keep 4-up early placement |
| Olifant / Canopy | Ticker / repeated footer stats | Skip both |
| Copy rules ([13-professional-copy](.cursor/rules/13-professional-copy.mdc)) | Verified claims only | Labels stay as locked |

**Locked metrics (unchanged):**

| Value | Label |
|-------|-------|
| `$112M+` | Revenue managed |
| `95%` | Client retention |
| `20+` | In-house specialists |
| `2018` | Helping sellers since |

## Design direction (professional, not dashboard)

One job: **quiet numeric proof** after logos — not a second card grid.

- **No section H2 / eyebrow** (numbers speak; avoids old-site marketing lines).
- **Quieter cells:** remove multi-layer “dashboard card” feel — drop `shadow-sm` and the top accent strip; use hairline dividers or a single light border / bottom rule.
- **Typography:** keep `text-stat` for values; value color = `text-primary` (navy) for agency gravity; accent reserved for CTAs elsewhere (avoids orange-number wall after navy/orange CTAs).
- **Rhythm:** Trust stays compact; Stats slightly more vertical air (`py-12`–`py-14`) so trust→stats→services breathes.
- **Grid:** `grid-cols-2` mobile → `lg:grid-cols-4` desktop; equal padding `p-5`/`p-6`.
- **Motion:** none in v1 (a11y + B3 lock).

## Implementation (after you approve execute)

1. **UI only** in [stats-section.tsx](src/components/sections/stats-section.tsx) — layout/classes; no JSON metric edits unless copy audit finds a label typo.
2. Confirm Trust no longer repeats `$112M+` text (B2 / Wave B — verify in [homepage.json](content/config/homepage.json) trust data).
3. Visual check: homepage desktop + mobile — spacing after marquee, 2×2 then 4-up, contrast vs atmosphere.
4. Log in [docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md); brief note in [docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md).

## Explicitly out of scope

- Services section (next after Stats when Stats is signed off)
- Count-up / win ticker / case-study metrics
- Inflating claims toward peer `$B` scale
- Restoring “Client success isn’t a goal…”

## Acceptance

- Four metrics only; labels match lock table
- Reads as proof strip, not card dashboard
- No duplicate `$112M+` in Trust
- Mobile 2×2 / desktop 4-up; no layout shift
- STATUS / VERIFIED with screenshot or Playwright note after execute

# Services section — research-backed polish plan

## Scope lock

**Next after Stats:** Services (`id: services`) — [homepage.json](content/config/homepage.json) order 4 of 14.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  stats[3_Stats]
  services[4_Services]
  creative[5_Creative]
  stats --> services --> creative
```

**Do not change:** six titles, descriptions, hrefs, Lucide icon names, heading/subheading (B4 locked). No stock photos on cards. No 7th service.

## Research summary

| Source | Finding | Adopt |
|--------|---------|-------|
| [B4 LOCKED](.cursor/plans/homepage_landing_audit_0b7e065e.plan.md) | 3×2 grid; 2-sentence depth; Lucide; “Amazon growth services” | Keep |
| [services-section.tsx](src/components/sections/services-section.tsx) | Content already matches lock; still reads as generic SaaS cards | Visual/UX polish only |
| [HOMEPAGE-VISUAL-AUDIT](docs/qa/HOMEPAGE-VISUAL-AUDIT-2026-09-03.md) | “Flat SaaS grid” P1; no random stock | Motif/structure, not photos |
| MAG / AMZ Dudes | Icon + title + short depth + link; quiet 01–06 | Already present; refine hierarchy |
| Atmosphere lock | Opaque muted bands avoided | Use `tone="muted"` = `bg-surface/35` only ([section-shell.tsx](src/components/sections/section-shell.tsx)) |

## Design direction (chosen)

One job after quiet Stats: **clear service catalog** — scannable, credible, not a startup feature wall.

1. **Section rhythm:** `SectionShell tone="muted"` (translucent) so Stats proof strip → Services soft band → Creative breathes.
2. **Card surface:** Keep [ElegantCard](src/components/ui/elegant-card.tsx) hover lift; drop nested `bg-background` fill that fights the band — transparent/inherit so cards sit in the soft band.
3. **Number hierarchy:** Soft large watermark-style `01`–`06` (low opacity, mono) instead of small competing corner label — AMZ Dudes scannability without noise.
4. **Icon tile:** Keep framed Lucide; retune framed style for this section to **primary/navy tint** (`border-primary/15`, `bg-primary/5`, icon `text-primary`) so accent orange stays for CTAs, not six orange tiles in a row.
5. **Whole-card link:** Wrap each card in one `Link` (title remains `h3`; visible “Learn more” + arrow stays for affordance). Single focusable target with `aria-label={`Learn more about ${title}`}`. Removes awkward double hit-targets.
6. **CTA row:** Keep visible “Learn more” + `ArrowRight`; use existing `Button variant="link"` (bouncy arrow via wrap). No PrimaryButton fill inside cards.
7. **Spacing:** Slightly tighter card internal stack (icon → title → body → link) so 3×2 doesn’t feel sparse after denser Trust.

## Implementation (after approve execute)

1. Update [services-section.tsx](src/components/sections/services-section.tsx) only (layout/UX). Touch [section-icon.tsx](src/components/sections/section-icon.tsx) with an optional `tone="primary" | "accent"` prop defaulting to current accent so other sections don’t regress.
2. No [homepage.json](content/config/homepage.json) copy edits unless a href 404 is found.
3. Spot-check six local routes resolve (or note known missing service pages).
4. Playwright: desktop 3-col + mobile 1-col; log [VERIFICATION-LOG.md](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md) + [SESSION-STATE.md](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md).

## Explicitly out of scope

- Creative showcase (B5) — next after Services sign-off
- Stock/illustration art on cards
- Extra services (DSP, Shopify, TikTok) in this six-pack
- Rewriting locked descriptions or “Pro-level” heading

## Acceptance

- Six cards; locked copy/hrefs/icons unchanged
- Soft muted band; no opaque wash block
- No six-orange icon wall; navy-framed icons
- Whole-card link keyboard-accessible; Learn more name includes title
- Grid: 1 → 2 (`md`) → 3 (`lg`); no overflow
- STATUS / VERIFIED with Playwright note after execute

input.plan:
# Seller segments — Growth Journey plan

## Scope lock

**Next after Creative Showcase:** Seller Segments (`id: seller-segments`) — [homepage.json](content/config/homepage.json) order 6 of 14.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  creative[5_Creative]
  segments[6_Segments]
  cases[7_Cases]
  creative --> segments --> cases
```

**Keep locked (B6):** three segments only (new / scaling / multi-ASIN); copy + CTA labels/hrefs already in JSON; no wholesale/enterprise; no pricing; no industry vertical spam.

## Research summary

| Source | Finding | Adopt |
|--------|---------|-------|
| [B6 LOCKED](.cursor/plans/homepage_landing_audit_0b7e065e.plan.md) | Self-identify then audit CTA; 3 stages | Journey metaphor matches “catalog stage” |
| AMZ Dudes / SalesDuo | Who-it’s-for segmentation | Clear paths, not generic cards |
| Current [seller-segments-section.tsx](src/components/sections/seller-segments-section.tsx) | Flat 3 Lucide cards — low “feel” after Services explorer + Creative mosaic | Replace layout, keep data |
| Services explorer (just shipped) | List + image preview | **Do not clone** — segments need a different interaction |

## Chosen innovative direction: Growth Journey

One job: visitor picks **where they are on the growth path**, then jumps to audit.

**Desktop**

- Horizontal **3-stage journey** with a continuous navy→accent connector line under stage markers (`01` → `02` → `03`).
- Each stage: large quiet number watermark, Lucide icon (navy framed), title.
- **Active stage** (hover / focus / default `scaling-brands` as middle “most common”): expands description + `PrimaryButton` CTA to `#hero-lead-form`.
- Inactive stages stay compact (title + icon + number) so the section feels alive, not three equal boxes.

**Mobile**

- Vertical timeline (same connector, top→bottom); tap/focus expands the active stage; one CTA visible at a time.

**Motion (OS-independent)**

- Expand/collapse + connector highlight via CSS classes with reduced-motion transition exemptions (same pattern as `.media-hover-zoom` / service explorer), not `motion-safe`-only.

**Why this vs tabs/cards**

- B6 rejected complex tab panels; journey keeps SSR-friendly markup (`ol` of stages) with progressive enhancement.
- Differentiates from Services explorer (no image swap wall).
- Subheading “matched to catalog stage” becomes literal UI.

## Implementation (after approve)

1. Rebuild [seller-segments-section.tsx](src/components/sections/seller-segments-section.tsx) as client interactive journey (state for active index; keyboard focus updates active).
2. Reuse [SectionIcon](src/components/sections/section-icon.tsx) `tone="primary"`; CTAs via [PrimaryButton](src/components/ui/primary-button.tsx) `asChild` → `#hero-lead-form`.
3. No JSON copy changes (already B6-locked). Light CSS helpers in [globals.css](src/app/globals.css) if needed for connector + expand.
4. Playwright: 3 stages, CTA hrefs, keyboard focus changes active; log [VERIFICATION-LOG.md](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md) + [SESSION-STATE.md](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md).

## Explicitly out of scope

- Case studies (B7)
- Fourth “enterprise/wholesale” segment
- Photography / AI images for this section
- Tab panels / industry vertical grid

## Acceptance

- Locked titles, descriptions, CTA labels unchanged
- Journey feel (connected stages), not 3 identical cards
- Distinct from Services explorer
- All CTAs → `#hero-lead-form` with focus-visible states
- Works with reduced-motion OS setting (transitions exempted)
- STATUS / VERIFIED after execute

input.plan:
# Case studies — Metric-led proof board

## Scope lock

**Next after Seller Segments:** Case Studies (`id: case-studies`) — [homepage.json](content/config/homepage.json) order 7 of 14.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  segments[6_Segments]
  cases[7_Cases]
  values[8_Values]
  segments --> cases --> values
```

**Keep locked (B7):**
- Three cases only: GoSports `/case-study-9/`, Kitchen `/case-study-1/`, Supplement `/case-study-2/`
- Metrics unchanged (`310%…`, `73%…`, `500 units…`)
- Heading/subheading/descriptions/CTA label+href (`/case-studies/`) unchanged
- No inventing metrics; no video; no adding cases 3–8

## Why current feels weak

[case-studies-section.tsx](src/components/sections/case-studies-section.tsx) is three identical `ElegantCard`s: navy slab + `object-contain` logo + metric chip. Same “card grid” language as older sections; metric is a small pill, not the hero; footer uses secondary `Button` not sitewide `PrimaryButton`.

## Chosen direction: Metric-led proof board

One job: visitor sees **outcome numbers first**, then brand, then reads the case.

**Desktop / tablet**
- Full-width `md:grid-cols-3` equal-height cards (`items-stretch`, no expand CLS).
- Top media band on `bg-surface` (not heavy navy fill) with logo `object-contain` and fixed aspect so height is stable.
- **Hero metric** under image as large accent typography (`text-stat` / similar), brand as H3, then category + service line, description, link.
- Entire card clickable via primary “Read case study” using [PrimaryButton](src/components/ui/primary-button.tsx) `asChild` → case href; footer “View all case studies” also PrimaryButton (outline/secondary pattern if PrimaryButton only has solid — use PrimaryButton for consistency with other homepage CTAs).

**Mobile**
- Single column stack; same structure; no horizontal overflow.

**Distinct from**
- Services explorer (no list+preview swap)
- Creative listing frame (no thumbs)
- Seller journey (no stages/connector)

**Assets**
- Keep existing JSON image paths (`gosports.png`, `case-kitchen-mark.png`, `case-supplement-mark.png`).
- Verify files exist under `public/images/cases/`; if missing, restore from `backup/` or prior archive before polish (no AI fake product shots for trademarked Culturelle/Farberware).
- No new AI generation unless assets are missing and only logo marks remain (then keep muted logo treatment).

## Implementation

1. Rebuild [case-studies-section.tsx](src/components/sections/case-studies-section.tsx): metric-first hierarchy, equal-height flex column, surface image band, PrimaryButton CTAs, focus-visible states.
2. No JSON copy/metric/href changes unless image paths need fix after file check.
3. Playwright: 3 cards, 3 case hrefs, footer CTA, equal heights / no CLS on resize; log [VERIFICATION-LOG.md](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md) + [SESSION-STATE.md](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md).

## Out of scope

- Brand values (B8)
- Case index page filters
- Featured GoSports span-2 (B7 rejected for this phase)
- AI category stock replacing brand marks

## Acceptance

- Locked metrics, brands, hrefs, copy unchanged
- Metric is clearest visual signal on each card
- Full-width, equal height, responsive stack
- Distinct from sections 4–6
- STATUS / VERIFIED after execute

input.plan:
# Case studies — Atmosphere proof cards (blur + zoom)

## Problem (Observed)

Current metric board still feels empty because media is **logo-on-white** (`gosports.png`, Farberware/Culturelle marks) with huge padding. Metric under the band helps hierarchy, but the top half has no atmosphere — so “proof” still looks like three logo tiles.

## Best innovative approach (chosen)

**Atmosphere proof cards** — category scene fills the frame; brand mark stays sharp; blur + zoom add depth without cloning Services / Creative / Journey.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  media[Media_band_fixed_aspect]
  blur[Blurred_scaled_AI_scene]
  sharp[Sharp_AI_scene_cover]
  logo[Sharp_brand_mark_badge]
  metric[Metric_on_gradient]
  body[Category_service_desc_CTA]
  media --> blur
  media --> sharp
  media --> logo
  media --> metric
  media --> body
```

### Media stack (per card)

1. **AI category atmosphere** (new 4:3 stills, no fake brand logos in the image):
   - GoSports → outdoor sports / backyard game product lifestyle
   - Kitchen → home kitchen cookware lifestyle
   - Supplement → clean wellness / supplement lifestyle
2. **Blur depth layer:** same atmosphere `object-cover`, `scale(1.2)`, `blur-xl`, low opacity — fills edges (same idea as Services letterbox fill).
3. **Sharp cover layer:** atmosphere with `.media-hover-zoom` (or case-specific class) — hover/focus **zoom** OS-independent (exempt in [globals.css](src/app/globals.css) like Creative).
4. **Brand mark badge:** existing JSON logos in a small frosted/white rounded tile (sharp, no blur) so trademarked marks stay readable and legal.
5. **Metric on media:** large accent `text-stat` on bottom navy/transparent gradient (outcome is the first read on the visual).

### Below media

- Brand H3, category, service chip, short description (locked copy)
- `PrimaryButton` “Read case study” + footer “View all case studies”

### Why this vs only blur-zooming logos

- Logo-only blur still looks like empty brand wallpaper.
- AI atmosphere gives real photography energy (what you liked on Segments/Creative).
- Blur + zoom become meaningful depth/motion, not gimmicks on flat white.

## Keep locked (B7)

- Metrics, brands, categories, services, descriptions, hrefs (`/case-study-9|1|2/`, `/case-studies/`)
- Three cards only; equal height; no video; no inventing metrics

## Files / assets

- Generate → `public/images/cases/*-atmosphere.jpg` (+ archive `assets/source/cases-ai-2026-09-08/`)
- Keep mark paths; extend JSON with `atmosphere` / `atmosphereAlt` (or `image` = atmosphere and `logo` = mark)
- Rebuild [case-studies-section.tsx](src/components/sections/case-studies-section.tsx)
- CSS helpers + reduced-motion exemptions for zoom/blur transitions
- Log [DOWNLOAD-LOG.md](docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md); verify Playwright + [VERIFICATION-LOG.md](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md) + [SESSION-STATE.md](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md)

## Acceptance

- Media feels full (not hollow white)
- Hover/focus: visible zoom; blur depth present at rest
- Metric dominant on card visual
- Locked proof data unchanged; 3 images load; equal heights; no CLS
- Distinct from sections 4–6

# Brand values — Editorial principles board

## Research summary

| Source | Finding | Implication |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| [B8 LOCKED](.cursor/plans/homepage_landing_audit_0b7e065e.plan.md) | 2x2 / stack; Lucide or number; **no** Elementor timeline; icons only; copy locked | Layout type is fixed; innovation = craft, not new IA |
| Current [brand-values-section.tsx](src/components/sections/brand-values-section.tsx) | 2x2 bordered cards + peach framed icons + mono 01–04 | Already B8-shaped but reads as generic SaaS tiles (same “card grid” fatigue after Cases/Segments) |
| Old site | “We’re Real…” timeline — copy rejected; timeline UI rejected | Keep pillar *ideas* only |
| Competitors (Olifant / MAG) | Principled voice after proof; MAG 4-pillar for *services* | Values must stay distinct from Services (B4) and Process (B9) |
| Recent UX feedback | Trust blur-on-every-logo felt **over**; Cases need atmosphere | Values should stay **calm** — philosophy, not another photo gallery |

Homepage rhythm now:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  cases[7_Cases_visual_proof]
  values[8_Values_principles]
  process[9_Process_steps]
  cases --> values --> process
```

After heavy Case atmosphere, Values should feel quieter and more editorial — not another interactive image system.

## Chosen direction: Editorial principles board

**One job:** explain *how we partner* (principles), not what we sell (Services) or the delivery sequence (Process).

**Desktop**
- Keep **2x2** (B8).
- Replace heavy equal “product cards” with **editorial cells**: hairline border or left accent rule, large quiet number watermark (`01`–`04`), compact Lucide (`SectionIcon` `tone="primary"`), title + body.
- Equal-height cells (`items-stretch`), full container width — no hollow max-width cluster.
- Hover: light border/primary emphasis only (no blur stacks, no image zoom).

**Mobile**
- Single column stack; same cell structure; no CLS.

**Why this (and not alternatives)**
- **Not** Services explorer / Seller journey — those are interactive discovery UIs; values are static principles.
- **Not** Case atmosphere AI photos — B8 assets = none; photos would blur “proof” vs “philosophy.”
- **Not** Elementor timeline — explicitly rejected in B8.
- **Not** Trust-style blur tiles on icons — user already flagged that as overdone.

## Keep locked (B8)

- Heading / subheading / four titles / four descriptions / icons in [homepage.json](content/config/homepage.json) unchanged
- No required CTA (optional foot link `#hero-lead-form` only if it stays one quiet text/PrimaryButton — prefer **omit** to avoid competing with Cases/Hero)
- Distinct from Process (next): values = principles; process = Audit→Report steps

## Implementation

1. Rebuild [brand-values-section.tsx](src/components/sections/brand-values-section.tsx) as editorial 2x2 principles board (numbers + icons + locked copy).
2. No JSON copy changes; no new image assets.
3. Playwright: 4 principles present, headings match lock, equal heights / no overflow; log [VERIFICATION-LOG.md](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md) + [SESSION-STATE.md](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md).

## Acceptance

- Locked copy unchanged
- Feels calmer and less “card spam” than current, distinct from sections 4–7 and Process
- Full-width, responsive, no layout shift
- STATUS / VERIFIED after execute

# Homepage restyle to Project One layout language

## Reference (Observed)

Site: [projectone.website](https://www.projectone.website/)

**Visual system (2-color punch theme)**
- Near-black charcoal surfaces / type (`~#131311`)
- Lime punch CTAs (`~#C6FD50`)
- Off-white page canvas (`~#FAFAFA`)
- Huge display headlines, sparse sections, sticky dark nav, pill CTAs, soft cards, motion/marquees

**Section patterns (not their copy)**
1. Sticky dark nav + primary CTA
2. Big hero + dual CTAs + guarantee line
3. Horizontal scrolling checklist ticker
4. Pain / “Sound familiar?” objections
5. Simple “ONE” value props
6. Brand intro + numbered process
7. Pricing / conversion card (they sell a plan)
8. Portfolio / work carousel
9. Comparison “smarter way”
10. Trust metrics
11. Testimonials
12. FAQ
13. Final CTA + footer

## Scope lock for eCom Gliders

- **Content:** eCom Gliders only (Amazon agency, services, cases, audit form, verified claims). Do not copy Project One wording or pricing.
- **2 colors (theme mapping):** Project One’s black+lime mapped to brand pair:
  - Dark / primary: `#0B1B3A` (navy)
  - Punch / accent: `#E47911` (Amazon orange)
  - Neutrals only: off-white canvas + muted gray text (not a third brand color)
- **Remove / quiet:** cyan wash, multi-gradient page atmosphere, multi-accent chrome — so the page reads as a strict 2-color system.
- **Pricing block:** Project One’s `$100/mo` does not apply. Replace that slot with a **Free audit conversion card** (hero-form style CTA + short inclusions), not invented agency packages.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  tokens[Lock_2color_tokens]
  chrome[Nav_Buttons_Type]
  sections[Rebuild_homepage_sections]
  compare[Screenshot_compare_vs_ProjectOne]
  tokens --> chrome --> sections --> compare
  compare -->|mismatch| sections
```

## Homepage IA remap (content stays ours)

| Project One pattern | eCom Gliders content source |
|---------------------|-----------------------------|
| Sticky nav + CTA | Existing header → dark bar, “Get a free audit” |
| Hero | Locked hero offer + dual CTA (audit / services or cases) |
| Checklist ticker | Deliverable/process checklist (SEO, PPC, listings, QA-style items from services/process) |
| Pain objections | New short seller-pain strip from known objections (no slang) |
| Simple value props | Brand values (4 pillars) in Project One “ONE” style cards |
| Intro + process | Process 01–04 + short agency intro |
| Conversion card | Free audit card (not pricing) |
| Portfolio | Creative showcase + case studies (work carousel / cards) |
| Comparison | Existing comparison table, restyled |
| Trust metrics | Stats + trust logos |
| Testimonials | Existing testimonials |
| FAQ | Existing FAQ |
| Final CTA | Final CTA + form |

Keep SEO/blog URL rules intact; this is homepage presentation, not blog migration.

## Implementation phases

### Phase A — Design tokens + chrome
- Update [content/config/design-system.json](content/config/design-system.json) / CSS vars: strict navy+orange; kill cyan page wash.
- Restyle [PrimaryButton](src/components/ui/primary-button.tsx): solid punch accent (orange) on dark, Project One–like pill weight.
- Header/footer: dark sticky nav, compact links, one loud CTA.

User only needs a short trigger. Agent loads this plan + `docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md` and runs the next unfinished pass automatically.

| Depth | When | What agent expands into steps |

| **deep** | New section, multi-file, motion, forms, or portfolio | Gap analysis + content mapping + a11y + Playwright flows + mobile/desktop + edge cases → log; may split sub-steps but still ONE section |

## Problem

- Attached **Trusted By** strip soft floating / double-border cards + dense logo stacks se **over** lagti hai; Project One pe trust/proof usually **sparse** (eyebrow + quiet logos, heavy card maze nahi).
- Pehle Pass 0–10 layout language laaye, lekin agent kabhi **andha implement** karta hai bina live PO screenshot compare ke — sticky/floating imagery, background atmosphere, card density miss ho jati hai.
- Locks same rehte hain: **eCom copy/claims/URLs only**; colors **navy `#0B1B3A` + orange `#E47911` + neutrals** (PO black/lime map); PO **layout/UI**, not PO words/pricing.

## Approach (chosen default)

1. Save a **reusable master prompt** in-repo so har nayi chat mein paste ho sake.
2. **First implementation pass = Trust bar simplify** (jo screenshot “over” dikha raha hai).
3. Phir **Fidelity Re-Pass queue** (header → footer), har pass: PO screenshot → our screenshot → gaps → one section only → Playwright verify → stop for approve.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  prompt[Master prompt paste]
  pick[Pick next pending section]
  shot[Screenshot PO analog + ours]
  plan[Write PASS header + Done when]
  impl[Implement only that section]
  verify[Playwright 1440 + 390]
  stop[Stop until next or approve]
  prompt --> pick --> shot --> plan --> impl --> verify --> stop
```

**Files:** [`src/components/sections/trust-bar-section.tsx`](src/components/sections/trust-bar-section.tsx), [`src/components/sections/trust-logo.tsx`](src/components/sections/trust-logo.tsx), optionally [`trust-client-marquee.tsx`](src/components/sections/trust-client-marquee.tsx)

# Project One visual rebuild (eCom content)

## Decision (locks change)

You said: **colors, fonts, and design/layouts = Project One; content = eCom Gliders only.**

That **overrides** the old lock (`navy #0B1B3A` + `orange #E47911` + IBM Plex only).

New visual system (from your PO screenshots):

- **Accent lime:** `#C6FD50` (PO reserve/CTA lime)
- **Ink black:** `#131311`
- **Canvas off-white:** `#FAFAFA`
- **Display/body font:** Satoshi (or Fontshare Satoshi) — replace IBM Plex as homepage display/sans
- **Chrome:** soft-rect ~10px, hard offset shadows (`4px 4px 0 #131311`), thick borders where PO has them
- **Content lock unchanged:** no PO copy, pricing plans, KHULA, Framer Expert claims, or fake urgency badges

Document this ADR in `docs/project/DECISIONS.md` + update `.cursor/rules/13-professional-copy.mdc` / design-system notes so agents stop re-applying navy/orange.

## Why previous work felt invisible

Prior passes only tweaked chrome on an already navy/orange site. PO’s signature is **lime + black + centered/orbit layouts**. Without palette + structure change, side-by-side never looked “dito.”

## Approach

1. **Pass 0 — Foundation:** tokens, font, `PrimaryButton`, nav pill, global chrome in [`content/config/design-system.json`](content/config/design-system.json), [`src/app/globals.css`](src/app/globals.css), [`src/app/layout.tsx`](src/app/layout.tsx), [`src/components/ui/primary-button.tsx`](src/components/ui/primary-button.tsx).
2. **One section per pass** matching your screenshot stack (below). Screenshot PO + ours @1440 before coding; verify 1440+390 after.
3. **Assets:** inventory eCom listing/case/browser visuals for Polaroid/orbit cards (no downloading PO client sites). Reuse [`BrowserMockup`](src/components/browser-mockup/) + creative/case images under `public/images/`.
4. **Save new plan + prompt:** `.cursor/plans/2026-09-15-po-visual-rebuild.md` and replace [`.cursor/prompts/PO-FIDELITY-MASTER.md`](.cursor/prompts/PO-FIDELITY-MASTER.md).

## Section map (PO visual → eCom content)

| Pass | PO visual (your shots) | Our section / files |

# Detect if PNGs are mostly grayscale by sampling unique colors via python
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
try:
    from PIL import Image
except ImportError:
    import subprocess, sys
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', 'pillow', '-q'])
    from PIL import Image

paths = list(Path('public/images/clients').glob('*.png'))
paths += list(Path('public/images/trust').glob('*.png'))
paths += list(Path('public/images/reviews').glob('*'))
paths += list(Path('public/images/press').glob('*.png'))
paths += [Path('public/images/amazon-verified-partner.png')]
paths += list(Path('public/images/cases').glob('*.png'))

def is_colored(path, sat_thresh=18, min_sat_pixels=0.02):
    im = Image.open(path).convert('RGBA')
    # downsample
    im = im.resize((80, 80))
    pixels = list(im.getdata())
    sat_count = 0
    opaque = 0
    for r,g,b,a in pixels:
        if a < 40: continue
        opaque += 1
        mx, mn = max(r,g,b), min(r,g,b)
        sat = mx - mn
        if sat >= sat_thresh:
            sat_count += 1
    if opaque == 0: return False, 0
    ratio = sat_count / opaque
    return ratio >= min_sat_pixels, round(ratio, 3)

for p in sorted(paths):
    colored, ratio = is_colored(p)
    print(f"{'COLOR' if colored else 'GREY '} {ratio:5.3f}  {p}")
PY

input.name: Services Pages Program
input.overview: A continuous, wave-based program to rebuild all 15 existing service pages into research-backed, conversion-focused pages with full SEO/AEO/GEO/AI-SEO coverage—kept on current root URLs—plus a reusable Master CONTINUE prompt you can re-send until the queue is done.
input.plan:
# Services Pages Master Program

## Locked decisions

- **Scope:** All **15** existing service pages in [`content/config/services/`](content/config/services/). No new URL inventing without inventory approval.
- **URL pattern stays root-level** (SEO / nav already locked): `/{slug}/` via [`src/app/(marketing)/[slug]/page.tsx`](src/app/(marketing)/[slug]/page.tsx). Not `/services/{slug}/` (would break nav + require redirects).
- **"Nested"** = mega-menu IA nesting (flagship / ads / listing / legal / channels) + deep multi-section pages—not nested URL paths.
- **Wave order (fixed):**
  1. **Wave A — Core 6** (homepage): Account Mgmt, PPC, Listing SEO, Content, Visual, Catalog
  2. **Wave B — Ads / ops:** DSP, Reporting
  3. **Wave C — Creative / legal / ops:** Video, Trademark, Company Registration, Product Sourcing
  4. **Wave D — Channels:** Shopify, TikTok Shop Ads, Email Retention
- **Content truth:** Verified claims only (`$112M+`, `95%` retention, `20+` specialists, since 2018). No fabricated case metrics. Marketplace claims must match homepage `#markets` / FAQ.
- **Visual system:** Project One hard chrome already on homepage (ink `#131311`, lime `#C6FD50`, Satoshi). Service template today is still older soft Card UI ([`service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx)) — must be upgraded once, then reused.

## Current state (verified)

| Layer | Status |
|-------|--------|
| Routes + SSG | Working shared `[slug]` |
| 15 JSON configs | Exist but mostly thin / template-level |
| Template sections | Hero, stats, problem, solution, deliverables, results, FAQ, related, CTA |
| Schema helpers | Service + FAQPage JSON-LD exist |
| SEO map | Only PPC + full-service well mapped; others stale “Not started” |
| URL inventory services table | Empty — must fill before claiming migration completeness |
| Old live site | Mostly `/services/#anchors`; only PPC + full-service were dedicated pages |

## Competitor bar (what “big agency” pages do)

From [`docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md`](docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md) + [`obsidian/09-Research/Niche-Website-Standards.md`](obsidian/09-Research/Niche-Website-Standards.md):

- Dedicated URL per service (not hash anchors)
- Commercial H1 + intent-matched title/meta
- Problem → method → deliverables → proof → FAQ → CTA
- 6–12 genuine FAQs with FAQPage schema
- Related services + case studies + audit CTA
- Comparison / “who this is for” blocks (AEO)
- Explicit entity language for GEO/LLM SEO (service name, company, outcomes)
- My Amazon Guy / Sequence depth as quality bar; never copy wording

## Target page architecture (every service page)

Upgrade template + JSON so each page contains:

1. **Hero** — H1, outcome subtitle, primary CTA (audit), secondary (case studies / related)
2. **Trust strip** — verified stats only (shared or page-specific)
3. **Who this is for** — seller stage / catalog type (conversion + AEO)
4. **Problem** — 4 pains (search-intent language)
5. **Solution / process** — 4–6 numbered steps
6. **Deliverables** — what’s included (scannable)
7. **Proof** — linked case studies or named metrics (only verified)
8. **How we differ** — short agency vs freelancer/DIY bullets (not full comparison page)
9. **FAQ** — 6–10 questions (AEO); Service + FAQPage schema
10. **Related services** — 3 links from same mega-menu cluster
11. **Final CTA** — audit form path `/free-audit-2/` or `#` hero form policy consistent with homepage

**Content depth targets:** Core commercial pages 1,500–2,500 words equivalent structure; secondary 1,200–1,800. Professional copy rules apply ([`.cursor/rules/13-professional-copy.mdc`](.cursor/rules/13-professional-copy.mdc)).

## SEO / AEO / GEO / AI-SEO checklist (per page — non-negotiable)

Before marking a page DONE, update [`docs/seo/SITE-SEO-MAP.md`](docs/seo/SITE-SEO-MAP.md) with:

- Search intent, primary + secondary keywords, entity
- Title (≤60), meta (≤155), H1, heading hierarchy
- Canonical, indexability, OG
- Schema: Service + FAQPage (+ BreadcrumbList if not already)
- Internal links: homepage ↔ service; service ↔ 3 related; service ↔ 1–2 blogs; service → audit
- AEO: definition block + FAQ answers that stand alone
- GEO: consistent company/service naming vs homepage/markets/FAQ
- LLM SEO: explicit terminology, no vague “growth magic”
- Technical: trailing slash, no orphan, mobile pass, LCP-safe images

Use skill [`.cursor/skills/seo-audit/SKILL.md`](.cursor/skills/seo-audit/SKILL.md) every page.

## Research gate (per wave, before writing)

For each service in the wave:

1. Read existing JSON + old backup page/hash content if present
2. Competitor pass (2–3 Tier B pages) via Playwright; log in [`docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md`](docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md)
3. Keyword/intent note in SITE-SEO-MAP (no keyword stuffing)
4. Only then rewrite JSON + template gaps

## Implementation phases

### Phase 0 — Foundation (once)

- Fill service rows in [`docs/seo/URL-INVENTORY.md`](docs/seo/URL-INVENTORY.md) (old hash vs new dedicated)
- Document redirect needs for `/services/` and `#service_*` in [`docs/seo/REDIRECT-MAP.md`](docs/seo/REDIRECT-MAP.md) (approve before implementing)
- Upgrade [`service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx) to PO chrome + missing sections (who-for, differ)
- Extend [`service-page.schema.ts`](src/domain/content/schemas/service-page.schema.ts) only if new fields required
- Save Master CONTINUE prompt to [`.cursor/prompts/SERVICES-MASTER-CONTINUE.md`](.cursor/prompts/SERVICES-MASTER-CONTINUE.md)

### Phase 1–4 — Waves A–D

For **each service** (strict one-page loop):

```
RESEARCH → SEO MAP ROW → JSON REWRITE → TEMPLATE FIX IF NEEDED →
SCHEMA VERIFY → INTERNAL LINKS → MOBILE/DESKTOP PLAYWRIGHT →
VERIFICATION-LOG → STOP FOR APPROVE → NEXT
```

Never batch-write all 15 contents in one shot without research evidence.

### Phase 5 — Program close

- Cross-link audit across all 15
- Sitemap / robots sanity
- Staging deploy
- SITE-SEO-MAP status = Implemented for all 15
- SESSION-STATE + CHAT-SUMMARIES update

## Master CONTINUE prompt (you paste this until queue empty)

Save and reuse (full text will be written to `.cursor/prompts/SERVICES-MASTER-CONTINUE.md` on execute):

```
You are continuing the eCom Gliders SERVICES PAGES MASTER PROGRAM.

RULES
- Project: migrate/build service pages for https://ecomgliders.com/ custom Next.js site.
```

# Service Visual Differentiation Program

## Goal

Stop the “same sections on every service” look. Keep conversion skeleton stable; differentiate mid-page with service-fit visual modules and real Seller Central / Ads proof from [growth.ecomgliders.com](https://growth.ecomgliders.com/).

## Chosen approach (default)

**Hybrid layout model**

- Fixed on every service: hero + lead form, FAQ, related services, final CTA
- Variable mid-page: 1–3 JSON-driven modules chosen from a shared catalog (browser/dashboard card, comparison table, process infographic, metric chart, proof gallery, checklist matrix)
- No invented metrics — only Verified site claims or growth proofs with provenance

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  continuePrompt[CONTINUE prompt] --> pickSlug[Pick next incomplete slug]
  pickSlug --> researchGate[Research layout fit + competitors + growth proofs]
  researchGate --> counselGate[Short counsel note: module recipe]
  counselGate --> schemaJson[Update schema + service JSON modules]
  schemaJson --> render[Render modules in ServicePageTemplate]
  render --> verify[Playwright + SEO + claim check]
  verify --> stopReport[STOP STATUS report]
```

## Why this fits the codebase

- Today [`service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx) renders one hard-chrome section stack for all 15 slugs.
- Reusable browser/chart chrome already exists in [`src/components/browser-mockup/`](src/components/browser-mockup/).
- Content lives in [`content/config/services/{slug}.json`](content/config/services/) — extend with a `modules[]` array rather than forking 15 templates.
- Growth funnel already exposes proof language and dashboard-style results (Observed on growth homepage: ACOS/ROAS/sales movement + “real dashboards · figures unedited”).

## Phase 0 — foundation (before first service CONTINUE)

1. **Growth proof inventory**
   - Playwright crawl `https://growth.ecomgliders.com/`
   - Catalog proof images / dashboard crops with path, claim text, service mapping
   - Download approved assets to `assets/source/growth/` then `assets/approved/growth/`
   - Log provenance in [`docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md`](docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md)
   - Output: [`docs/research/GROWTH-PROOF-INVENTORY.md`](docs/research/GROWTH-PROOF-INVENTORY.md)

2. **Module catalog + schema**
   - Add Zod `modules` to [`service-page.schema.ts`](src/domain/content/schemas/service-page.schema.ts)
   - Supported types (v1): `browserProof`, `comparisonTable`, `processSteps`, `metricChart`, `proofGallery`, `checklistMatrix`
   - Shared renderers under `src/components/services/modules/`
   - Wire optional `modules` into [`service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx) between problem/solution and results (exact slot per recipe)

3. **Service layout recipe matrix**
   - Document in [`docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md`](docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md)

| Service type | Primary modules |
|---|---|
| PPC / DSP / Reporting | browserProof + metricChart + comparisonTable |
| Listing / Content / Visual / Video | proofGallery + beforeAfter or processSteps |
| Catalog / Trademark / Company / Sourcing | checklistMatrix + processSteps + comparisonTable |
| Shopify / TikTok / Email | browserProof or proofGallery + processSteps |

4. **Master CONTINUE prompt file**
   - Replace/extend [`.cursor/prompts/SERVICES-MASTER-CONTINUE.md`](.cursor/prompts/SERVICES-MASTER-CONTINUE.md) with the Visual Differentiation CONTINUE block below (also pasteable in chat).

5. **Counsel gate**
   - Before coding modules for a slug: write 5–8 line recipe in SESSION-STATE (modules chosen, growth assets, why). User can APPROVE recipe or say CONTINUE to accept and build.

## Per-CONTINUE execution (one slug)

1. Read SESSION-STATE + SITE-SEO-MAP + layout recipe matrix; pick next incomplete visual slug.
2. Research gate: competitors’ service-page patterns + growth proofs mapped to this service + keyword/intent refresh if needed.
3. Counsel note: proposed modules + asset list (STOP only if user asked for recipe approval; otherwise proceed when they said CONTINUE).
4. Download/map growth assets for that slug; provenance log.
5. Fill `modules[]` in `content/config/services/{slug}.json` (keep hero.form + conversion copy).
6. Add module renderer pieces only if a new type is required.
7. Verify Playwright desktop+mobile: modules render, no fake claims, schema valid, no PO copy leak, form still works.
8. Log VERIFICATION-LOG + SESSION-STATE; STOP with STATUS / IMPLEMENTED / VERIFIED / REMAINING / NEXT ACTION.

## Queue (visual wave — skip completed)

Same slug order A1–D3. Track a new status column conceptually: `Visual layout: Pending | Implemented`.

Start A1 `full-service-amazon-agency` after Phase 0, unless user says WAVE FOUNDATION only.

## Master CONTINUE prompt (auto — paste each turn)

```text

- Project: custom Next.js service pages for https://ecomgliders.com/

ON EACH CONTINUE
1) Read docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md + docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md; pick next incomplete visual slug.
2) If Phase 0 incomplete (module schema/renderers + growth inventory + recipes doc + this prompt), finish Phase 0 first.
3) Full research gate for THIS slug only:
   - current page JSON + live local page

4) Write a short counsel recipe in SESSION-STATE (modules + assets + why). Then implement in the same turn unless I said RECIPE ONLY.

DONE for a service (visual wave)

- Visual differentiation vs generic stack is obvious
- Verification evidence recorded
```

## Out of scope for this wave

- Staging/production deploy (still Requires confirmation / APPROVE)
- Rewriting all conversion copy from scratch again
- Fake animated “ROI calculators” without real data

## First implementation target after approval

2. Then CONTINUE → A1 full-service visual modules

## Research verdict (evidence)

- **Gap (Verified):** New Next.js app has 15 root `/{slug}/` service pages, but **no All Services index**. Mega menu footer “View all services” incorrectly points to [`/full-service-amazon-agency/`](content/config/navigation.json).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  nav[MegaMenu View all services] --> hub["/services/"]
  home[Homepage services CTA] --> hub
  hub --> flagship["/full-service-amazon-agency/"]
  hub --> groupA["Advertising and Growth"]

```

## Page sections (build this order)

### 1. Hero
- **Job:** Brand + one H1 + one support line + CTA group (audit + phone).
- **H1 (Proposed):** `Amazon growth services for serious sellers`
- **Support:** Owned-channel and foundation services complement Amazon; Amazon remains the core engine.
- **CTA:** Free audit (`/free-audit-2/`) + existing phone.
- **Keep lean:** no stats strip in first viewport (hero budget rule).

### 2. Capability jump nav
- **Job:** One-scan map of the 4 groups with in-page anchors (`#advertising-growth`, `#catalog-content`, `#brand-operations`, `#channels-dtc`).
- **Why:** Competitor hubs and our mega menu already teach this taxonomy; reduces scroll friction on 15 items.

### 3. Flagship band — Full Account Management
- **Job:** Elevate the flagship engagement above the grid.
- **Content:** Short pitch from [`full-service-amazon-agency.json`](content/config/services/full-service-amazon-agency.json) hero/subtitle; CTA to that page.
- **Why:** Live WP and mega menu already treat account management as featured.

### 4–7. Four category catalogs (core of the page)

Each category section:
- Category H2 + one-line purpose
- Grid of service cards: title, 1–2 sentence blurb, href to root slug
- Optional small icon from existing icon set (no emoji)
- Stable `id` per service for future hash redirects where useful

| Section id | Services (href) |
|---|---|
| `#advertising-growth` | Full-service, PPC, DSP, Reporting |
| `#catalog-content` | Listing optimization, Content writing, Visual creativity, Video creative, Catalog management |

| `#channels-dtc` | Shopify, TikTok Shop ads, Email retention |

Blurbs: rewrite professionally from each service JSON `hero.subtitle` / problem summary — not WP “Get More Than You Pay For” tone.

### 8. How the stack works together
- **Job:** One section explaining connected delivery (ads + listings + creative + ops + complementary channels).
- **Pattern:** 3–4 process steps (audit → priorities → execution → reporting) — reuse tone from service `solution.steps`, no new metrics.
- **Why:** Differentiates vs pure PPC mills / TikTok-first agencies already documented in COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.

### 9. Proof strip
- **Job:** Credibility without inventing case results.
- **Content:** Existing verified stats only (same as service pages). Optional Amazon Ads Verified Partner badge already used in mega CTA.

### 10. Featured results
- **Job:** Bridge to `/case-studies/` with 2–3 existing verified cards (e.g. GoSports 310%, kitchen 73% — already used across services).
- **CTA:** View all case studies.

### 11. FAQ
- **Job:** Hub-level AEO questions only (genuine):

  - Do Shopify/TikTok replace Amazon?
  - Which marketplaces?
  - How does the free audit work?
- Schema: `FAQPage` + `CollectionPage` / `ItemList` of services (mirror case-studies JSON-LD approach).

- Same conversion close as service pages: free audit, no obligation, phone/email.

input.plan:
# Services Hub Hero + Catalog Layout Refresh

## Problem (Observed)

Current `/services/` feels flat:
- Hero in [`services-index-hero.tsx`](src/components/services/services-index-hero.tsx) is a plain left text stack (eyebrow + H1 + subtitle + buttons) with no visual plane.
- Jump nav chips in [`services-index-nav.tsx`](src/components/services/services-index-nav.tsx) are a weak second section.
- Catalog in [`services-index-categories.tsx`](src/components/services/services-index-categories.tsx) repeats the same 3-column image card grid four times — readable but not modern.
- Flagship band is a separate ink box that competes with hero instead of composing with it.

## Research direction (Observed)

Modern agency hubs use:
- Full-bleed / split editorial hero with oversized type + one dominant visual + dual CTAs
- Capability filters near the catalog (sticky rail or integrated chips)
- Mixed catalog rhythm: wide featured row + compact cards, or sticky left category heading while cards scroll on the right

Stay inside eCom Gliders system: PO ink / lime / hard chrome borders + hard shadows. No purple gradients, no cream-serif broadsheet look, no emoji icons.

## Locked design

### A. Hero — ink stage + capability strip

Replace plain hero with one composition (first viewport):

```
[ ink full-bleed band ]
  left: eyebrow · H1 · one support line · primary + phone CTA
  right: dominant collage of 2 service images (hard chrome frames, lime shadow)
  bottom edge of hero: 4 capability chips (scroll anchors) — merges old jump nav
```

Rules:
- Keep H1/copy from [`services-index.json`](content/config/services-index.json); tighten subtitle if needed for one-line support.
- No stats in hero.
- Flagship CTA can appear as a slim lime-outlined link under CTAs (“Explore full-service management”) so the separate fat flagship section can be removed or demoted.

Files: rewrite [`services-index-hero.tsx`](src/components/services/services-index-hero.tsx); pass `categories` + 2 featured image refs from template; delete or stop rendering standalone [`services-index-nav.tsx`](src/components/services/services-index-nav.tsx) and [`services-index-flagship.tsx`](src/components/services/services-index-flagship.tsx) from [`services-index-template.tsx`](src/components/services/services-index-template.tsx).

### B. Catalog — sticky category rail + mixed rows

Replace four repeated grids with one continuous catalog section:

```
desktop:
  left sticky (top under header): category list with counts + active state on scroll
  right: for each category
    - category H2 + one-line purpose
    - featured service (if any) as wide horizontal media+copy row
    - remaining services as 2-column compact image cards

mobile:
  sticky horizontal chip scroller (same anchors)
  then same mixed rows stacked
```

Card interaction stays link-whole-tile (good). Keep hard borders + hover hard-shadow. Use existing AI service images already in `public/images/services/*-service.jpg`.

Optional motion (2–3 intentional): chip active underline, sticky rail highlight on intersect, subtle image scale on card hover (already present — keep restrained).

### C. Keep below the fold unchanged

Do not redesign stack / proof / results / FAQ / final CTA in this pass — only hero + catalog rhythm.

## Config / schema

Minimal config tweaks in [`services-index.json`](content/config/services-index.json):
- `hero.visualImages`: two image paths + alts for hero collage (from existing hub AI set)
- Keep categories/services as-is (already have image/imageAlt)

Schema update in [`services-index.schema.ts`](src/domain/content/schemas/services-index.schema.ts) for `hero.visualImages`.

## Implementation steps

1. Update schema + JSON for hero visuals.
2. Rebuild hero component (ink stage + collage + integrated chips).
3. Rebuild categories into sticky-rail + mixed-row catalog (new component or rewrite existing).
4. Wire template section order: Hero → Catalog → Stack → Proof → Results → FAQ → CTA.
5. Playwright desktop/mobile: H1/canonical, 15 links, chip anchors scroll, sticky rail usable, no PO leak, images load.
6. Log [`docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md`](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md) + [`docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md`](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md).

## Out of scope

- Regenerating service card images again
- Changing root service detail URLs
- Homepage services section
- Staging deploy (await APPROVE)

## Research findings (Verified / Observed)

- **Featured-with-list** (high fit for 3–5 items per category): one large interactive lead + compact sibling rows.
- **Quiet in-page anchors**: sticky text links after hero exits; not pill filter chrome (Stripe product subnav pattern adapted as text rail — avoid purple Stripe palette).
- **Equal peer card grids**: anti-pattern when repeated ×4 for 15 services.
- **Marketplace search / side filter dashboard**: reject — wrong scale for 15 services.
- **Ink authority stage**: accept as typography-led full-bleed ink; reject AI product collage / cream split / hero badges / purple glow.

## Counsel verdict on prior draft

| Draft piece | Verdict |
|-------------|---------|
| Ink hero + image collage + chips in hero | **MODIFY** — keep ink stage; **reject collage and hero chips** |
| Sticky left pill/count rail + 2-col image cards | **MODIFY** — soft sticky **text** rail; featured row + **editorial compact rows** (not equal image cards) |
| Remove standalone nav/flagship from template | **ACCEPT** |
| Keep stack / proof / results / FAQ / CTA | **ACCEPT** |

## Locked design (implement after APPROVE)

### A. Hero — typography-led ink stage

- **One** primary CTA: Request a free audit
- Phone as quiet text link (not peer button weight)
- Optional slim lime-outline text link: Explore full-service management → `/full-service-amazon-agency/`
- **No** stats, collage, eyebrow "SERVICES", floating badges, purple/glow

input.plan:
# Service page duplicate counsel

## Verdict

Same facts are told 2–3 times because core sections and hybrid modules overlap. Fix in the **renderer** first (JSON can stay for later cleanup).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  hero[Hero + trust line]
  problem[Problem Fit Matrix]
  audience[Audience Fit Matrix]
  solution[Solution Process Spine]
  deliverables[Deliverables Spec Sheet]
  modules[Modules gallery and tables]
  differ[Differ Contrast Board]
  results[Results]
  faq[FAQ]
  related[Related]
  pageCta[Page BlogPostCta]
  footerCta[Footer PreFooterCta]

  solution -.->|DUPLICATE| modProcess[processSteps module]
  deliverables -.->|DUPLICATE| modCheck[checklistMatrix module]
  differ -.->|NEAR DUPLICATE| modCompare[comparisonTable module]
  pageCta -.->|DUPLICATE| footerCta
```

## Keep / remove

| Job | Keep | Suppress |
|---|---|---|
| Trust claims | Hero trust line (already done) | Stats cards / stats strip (already removed) |
| How we work | `solution` Process Spine | `processSteps` modules |
| What you get | `deliverables` Spec Sheet | `checklistMatrix` modules |
| Why us | `differ` Contrast Board | `comparisonTable` when `differ` exists |
| Visual proof | `proofGallery` / `browserProof` / other unique modules | — |
| Close | Page `BlogPostCta` (service-specific) | Footer `PreFooterCta` when `#blog-post-cta` is on the page |

Keep as-is: problem, audience, results, FAQ, related, unique image modules.

## Implementation (renderer-only)

1. **[`service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx)**  
   Before `<ServiceModules>`, filter modules:
   - drop `type === "processSteps"`
   - drop `type === "checklistMatrix"`
   - drop `type === "comparisonTable"` when `service.differ` is present  
   Pass filtered list into `ServiceModules`.

2. **[`site-footer.tsx`](src/components/layout/site-footer.tsx) + [`pre-footer-cta.tsx`](src/components/layout/pre-footer-cta.tsx) / marketing layout**  
   When page has `#blog-post-cta`, do not render `PreFooterCta` (same `has-[#blog-post-cta]` pattern already used for gap). Keeps one ink close with service copy.

3. **Verify** on Shopify + one ads page (e.g. PPC/DSP): no double process, no double checklist, no double CTA stack; proof images still show.

## Out of scope for this pass

- Deleting duplicate blocks from every service JSON (can follow after UI looks right)
- Rewriting FAQ / results copy
- Changing related-services layout

# Move promo out of topbar (MAG-aligned)

## Research evidence (Verified)

[myamazonguy.com](https://myamazonguy.com/) homepage (Playwright, 2026-10-15):

- **No people/packages flash strip in header chrome.** Header is clean white nav; Free Audit is a nav text link; Fast Quote is a nav button.
- **People photo lives in the hero** as a large cutout (Steven, ~581x357), not compressed into a 77px bar.
- **Campaign offer sits under the hero** as a full-width linked banner image (`q4-bfcm-2026-homepage-banner-3`, ~1288x106, page Y ~573) — after hero content, before deeper page content.

## Counsel

Topbar is the wrong slot for this creative:

- Cramped height fights team + packages + copy + CTA.
- Competes with nav and first-paint brand moment.
- MAG (category peer) never puts this kind of offer in the announcement chrome; they use **post-hero full-bleed campaign band**.

**Decision:** Disable promo in the site header. Rehome the same offer as a homepage section in MAG’s under-hero slot (after `hero`, before `checklist-ticker` / trust flow).

Keep eCom Gliders ink stage, team cutout, packages, simple red CTA — but as a **wider section band** (~140–180px desktop) with equal rails and breathing room, not a sticky chrome strip.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph before [Current]
    TB[TopbarPromo]
    Nav[Nav]
    Hero1[Hero]
  end
  subgraph after [Target]
    Nav2[CleanNav]
    Hero2[Hero]
    Band[PromoAuditBand]
    Rest[TrustAndBelow]
  end
  TB -.->|remove| Nav2
  Hero2 --> Band --> Rest
```

## Implementation

1. **Disable topbar promo** in [`content/config/site.json`](content/config/site.json): set `announcementBar.enabled` to `false` (or `variant: "ai"` only if Ask-AI strip is wanted later — default off for clean MAG-like header).

2. **Add homepage section type** `promoAuditBand` in [`src/domain/content/schemas/homepage.schema.ts`](src/domain/content/schemas/homepage.schema.ts).

3. **Refactor UI** — extract presentational layout from [`promo-announcement-bar.tsx`](src/components/layout/promo-announcement-bar.tsx) into a section component e.g. [`src/components/sections/promo-audit-band-section.tsx`](src/components/sections/promo-audit-band-section.tsx):
   - Full-bleed ink band inside `SectionShell` (or edge-to-edge wrapper)
   - Same assets/copy fields (headline, body, cta, left/right/badge images)
   - Taller than topbar: `min-h ~9–11rem`, rails ~200px, simple red CTA (no lime under-shadow)
   - Wire in [`homepage-section-renderer.tsx`](src/components/sections/homepage-section-renderer.tsx)

4. **Insert in** [`content/config/homepage.json`](content/config/homepage.json) immediately after `hero`, `enabled: true`, copy/images from current `announcementBar.promo` (headline, body with no-obligation, Schedule Call → `/free-audit-2/`, team cutout + packages + stamp).

5. **Keep** topbar component path for future events, but unused while disabled — no duplicate render.

6. **Verify** with Playwright: header has no promo strip; band appears under hero; screenshot desktop + mobile; log in [`docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md`](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md) + short note in [`docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md`](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md) / research log.

## Success criteria

- Topbar clean (no promo) — Verified
- Promo band under hero, MAG campaign-slot placement — Verified
- Same offer story (team / audit / packages / Schedule Call) with more height — Verified
- Existing `freeAuditCard` mid-page section stays (deeper conversion); band is the event/attention strip only

# Move promo to post-hero campaign slider (MAG-aligned)

## Research evidence (Verified)

[myamazonguy.com](https://myamazonguy.com/) homepage (Playwright, 2026-10-15):

- **No people/packages flash strip in header chrome.** Clean white nav; Free Audit = nav link; Fast Quote = nav button.
- **People photo lives in the hero** as a large cutout (Steven), not a 77px topbar.
- **Under-hero slot is a carousel, not one static banner.** Widget: `elementor-widget-exad-logo-carousel` / Slick. Placement: after hero, above trust logos. Height ~106px, width ~1290px.
- **Verified slides (4):**
  1. Q4 and BFCM Full Funnel Marketing Masterclass
  2. MagSchool 75% off (Oct 2026)
  3. Amazon Turkey 12 Benchmark and War Room 2026
  4. The $1M Amazon Roadmap
- Each slide is a full-width linked creative (~1536x127 source). Autoplay rotates offers.

Screenshots: `docs/qa/screenshots/research-mag-banner-carousel-*.png`

## Counsel

Topbar is wrong for this creative (cramped, fights nav). MAG pattern to copy is:

**Post-hero full-width campaign slider** — many offers in one slot, rotate.

**Decision:** Disable topbar promo. Add homepage `promoCampaignSlider` immediately after `hero`. Slide 1 = current Free Audit offer (team / copy / CTA / packages). Add more slides via JSON so events can rotate like MAG without touching the header.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph mag [MyAmazonGuy]
    MagHero[Hero]
    MagSlider[CampaignCarousel_4slides]
    MagTrust[TrustLogos]
    MagHero --> MagSlider --> MagTrust
  end
  subgraph us [eComGlidersTarget]
    Nav[CleanNav]
    Hero[Hero]
    Slider[PromoCampaignSlider]
    Rest[ChecklistTrustAndBelow]
    Nav --> Hero --> Slider --> Rest
  end
```

## Design (ours, MAG slot grammar)

- Full-bleed ink band, ~120–160px desktop (slightly taller than MAG image-only strip so composed team+CTA stays readable).
- **Carousel:** one slide visible, autoplay ~5s, pause on hover, dot indicators; no heavy library — CSS scroll-snap or lightweight React state (framer-motion already in repo if useful).
- Slide types in content:
  - `composed` — left image + headline/body + CTA + optional right image (Free Audit)
  - `image` — full-bleed linked creative (future event art like MAG)
- Config-driven `slides[]` in homepage JSON; no hardcoded campaigns in components.

## Implementation

1. **Disable topbar promo** in [`content/config/site.json`](content/config/site.json): `announcementBar.enabled: false`.

2. **Schema** — add `promoCampaignSlider` to [`homepage.schema.ts`](src/domain/content/schemas/homepage.schema.ts).

3. **Section UI** — [`src/components/sections/promo-campaign-slider-section.tsx`](src/components/sections/promo-campaign-slider-section.tsx):
   - Autoplay + dots + `aria-roledescription="carousel"`
   - Reuse composed layout from [`promo-announcement-bar.tsx`](src/components/layout/promo-announcement-bar.tsx) as a slide renderer (simple red CTA, no lime under-shadow)
   - Wire in [`homepage-section-renderer.tsx`](src/components/sections/homepage-section-renderer.tsx)

4. **Homepage content** — insert after `hero` in [`homepage.json`](content/config/homepage.json):
   - Slide 1: Free Audit composed (current promo assets/copy, CTA `/free-audit-2/`)
   - Slides 2–3: seed with real eCom Gliders offers only if we have honest creatives; otherwise start with **2 slides** — Audit + a second composed offer using existing verified services messaging (e.g. PPC review / case-studies CTA). Do not invent MagSchool-style fake discounts.
   - Prefer image-link slides later when event art exists.

5. **Keep** topbar component unused while disabled.

6. **Verify** Playwright: no header promo; slider under hero; at least 2 slides rotate; desktop + mobile screenshots; update SESSION-STATE + VERIFICATION-LOG + short research note.

## Success criteria

- Topbar clean (no promo) — Verified
- Under-hero **slider** with multiple slides (MAG slot) — Verified
- Slide 1 = Free Audit story — Verified
- No invented competitor discounts or unverified claims — Verified
- Mid-page `freeAuditCard` stays as deeper conversion block
