# Client video reviews (Favrick-style reels)

## Research (Verified)

**Favrick** ([favrick-preview.vercel.app](https://favrick-preview.vercel.app/)):
- “Shop by video” — horizontal portrait cards (~220x391), muted loop autoplay MP4s
- Click opens dialog (`role=dialog`, body scroll locked) with larger video + `1 / N` pager

**ecomgliders.com** — Vimeo set to reuse:
- Client reviews carousel: `1079374516`, `1079374584`, `1079374772`, `1079372332`
- Featured story: `1168263614` (Patrick / Les Plaisirs)
- Agency/creative reel: `1076971749` (homepage / about — include as optional last card or omit from reviews strip)
- YouTube audit sample: `XHOmBV4js_E` on `/free-audit-2/` (out of scope for reviews reel)

**growth.ecomgliders.com** — no video embeds. Reuse later (not reels): Trustpilot crops `tp-1…4`, WhatsApp `wa-1…3`, sales dashboard AVIFs ([growth.ecomgliders.com](https://growth.ecomgliders.com/)).

**Existing code to leverage:**
- Lightbox pattern: [`image-preview-dialog.tsx`](src/components/services/modules/image-preview-dialog.tsx) (Radix Dialog)
- Homepage section plumbing: [`homepage.schema.ts`](src/domain/content/schemas/homepage.schema.ts) + [`homepage-section-renderer.tsx`](src/components/sections/homepage-section-renderer.tsx)
- Keep text quotes in [`testimonials`](content/config/homepage.json) — add a **new** section rather than deleting quotes

## Chosen UX

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  strip[ReelStrip_mutedPosters]
  click[ClickCard]
  dialog[VideoPreviewDialog]
  vimeo[VimeoIframe]
  strip --> click --> dialog --> vimeo
```

- **Strip:** horizontal scroll, portrait hard cards (brand border + ink shadow), poster from `https://vumbnail.com/{vimeoId}.jpg` (same source live PPC page uses), play affordance, name/company caption
- **Inline preview:** no autoplay iframe in strip (Vimeo privacy often blocks background loops) — static poster + muted feel via design; optional CSS motion only
- **Lightbox:** extend preview dialog for Vimeo iframe (`player.vimeo.com/video/{id}?autoplay=1`), prev/next + counter like Favrick, Escape/close same as image preview
- **Placement:** new homepage section `videoReviews` **after `case-studies`, before `testimonials`**
- **Initial slides (6):** four client IDs + Patrick `1168263614` + agency reel `1076971749` (Rizwan set + live carousel completeness)

## Implementation

1. **Content** — add `videoReviews` section in [`homepage.json`](content/config/homepage.json) with `items[]`: `vimeoId`, `title`, `name`, `company` (verified names from live/backup where known; generic “Client review” if name unknown).
2. **Schema** — register `videoReviews` in [`homepage.schema.ts`](src/domain/content/schemas/homepage.schema.ts).
3. **UI**
   - [`video-reviews-section.tsx`](src/components/sections/video-reviews-section.tsx) — SectionShell + horizontal reel
   - [`video-preview-dialog.tsx`](src/components/sections/video-preview-dialog.tsx) — fork of image preview for Vimeo + index pager
   - Wire renderer case
4. **Config** — allow `vumbnail.com` and `player.vimeo.com` / `i.vimeocdn.com` in [`next.config.ts`](next.config.ts) `images.remotePatterns` for posters.
5. **Growth assets (phase companion, same PR only if quick):** document Trustpilot/WhatsApp URLs in DOWNLOAD-LOG; do not block reels on downloading them. Download + optional “Written reviews” strip can follow after reels ship.
6. **Verify** — Playwright: strip visible, click opens dialog with iframe, next/prev, close; mobile scroll; screenshots under `docs/qa/screenshots/`.

## Success criteria

- Homepage shows portrait video-review reel (Verified)
- Click opens full preview dialog with Vimeo play (Verified)
- Uses only owned Vimeo IDs from live site / Rizwan list (Verified)
- Text testimonials section still present (Verified)

input.command:
IDS="1168263614 1079374516 1079374584 1079374772 1079372332 1076971749"
SRC="assets/source/video-reviews"
for id in $IDS; do
  echo "=== $id ==="
  curl -fsSL -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://player.vimeo.com/video/${id}/config" -o "$SRC/config-${id}.json" && python -c "
import json,sys
p=r'$SRC/config-${id}.json'
d=json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8'))
files=d.get('request',{}).get('files',{})
prog=files.get('progressive') or []
hls=(files.get('hls') or {}).get('cdns')
thumbs=d.get('video',{}).get('thumbs') or d.get('video',{}).get('thumbnail_url')
print('title', d.get('video',{}).get('title'))
print('duration', d.get('video',{}).get('duration'))
print('thumbs', thumbs)
print('progressive', [(f.get('quality'), f.get('width'), f.get('url','')[:80]) for f in prog[:4]])
print('hls_keys', list(hls.keys()) if isinstance(hls,dict) else None)
" || echo "config fail"
done

{"name": "Case studies enterprise UX", "overview": "Research-backed counsel and phased plan to rebuild /case-studies/ hub and /case-study-N/ detail pages into enterprise-grade, layout-variant proof experiences—preserving legacy URLs and only using verified metrics.", "plan": "# Case studies: enterprise presentation (research + counsel)

## Scope (chosen)

Rebuild **both** the hub ([`/case-studies/`](src/app/(marketing)/case-studies/page.tsx)) and detail templates ([`case-study-detail-template.tsx`](src/components/case-studies/case-study-detail-template.tsx)), driven by extended JSON in [`content/config/case-studies.json`](content/config/case-studies.json). **Preserve** existing paths `/case-studies/` and `/case-study-1/` … `/case-study-9/` (SEO non-negotiable).

This session deliverable after approval: research note + schema/layout plan; **no implementation until you APPROVE**.

---

## Current state (Verified)

- **9 studies**, filters by `serviceFilter`, 3-col card grid ([`case-studies-grid.tsx`](src/components/case-studies/case-studies-grid.tsx)).
- Detail is a single linear template: Hero → Challenge → Solution steps → Results cards → optional Quote → blog CTA ([`case-study-detail-template.tsx`](src/components/case-studies/case-study-detail-template.tsx)).
- Schema already has `quote` but **no study uses it**; **8/9** share the same 3 generic solution steps; only **GoSports (`case-study-9`)** is narrative-grade.
- Visual language on hub/detail is softer than Project One hard-chrome used on homepage/services.
- Homepage proof strip ([`case-studies-section.tsx`](src/components/sections/case-studies-section.tsx)) is a **separate** data path from the hub.

---

## Competitor research (Observed / Verified 2026-10-15)

| Source | Pattern to steal (concept, not copy) | Avoid |
|--------|--------------------------------------|--------|
| **Canopy** ([canopymanagement.com/case-studies](https://canopymanagement.com/case-studies/)) | Outcome-first cards (`+579%`, `$722K`, TACoS); brand trust wall; award/proof density | Inflating portfolio stats we cannot verify |
| **AgentsUp** ([agentsup.com/case-studies](https://www.agentsup.com/case-studies)) | Vertical + market chips; “Brand withheld” honesty; KPI block before story; multi-vertical grid | Inventing dashboard figures |
| **Sellexio** | Short hub “3 problems / 3 outcomes”; detail = Challenge → Approach → Numbers; service tags | Thin pages with only bullets |
| **Mazescale** | Category-named stories; result bullets above fold | Vague “efficiency gains” without numbers |
| **B2B best practice** (Grafit synthesis) | Outcome title, proof block + timeframe, TOC/anchors, quote, CTA that matches story | PDF-only case studies; empty alts |

**EG positioning (from existing [`COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md`](docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md)):** mid-market between conversion shops and Canopy-scale premium — aim **Tier B boutique premium + Canopy/AgentsUp proof mechanics**, not enterprise fake scale.

---

## Counsel (WHAT / WHY / HOW)

**WHAT:** Treat case studies as a **proof product**, not a blog archive. Hub = scannable KPI gallery; detail = **layout variant** by engagement type; content depth must match the template (no empty flagship chrome).

**WHY:** Buyers compare agencies on verifiable outcomes. Current one-template + templated steps undercuts GoSports-level proof and loses to AgentsUp/Canopy on first scroll.

**HOW — hub**
1. PO hard-chrome hero (eyebrow + H1 + one-line proof thesis).
2. **Featured strip** for GoSports (and later any `featured: true`).
3. Filters: keep service filters; add **category** chips when data exists.
4. Cards: dominant metric, client or “Brand (category)”, 1-line excerpt, service badge — **no empty image alts**.
5. Closing CTA: Free Audit (existing pattern), not blog CTA.

**HOW — detail layouts (content-driven `layout` field)**

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  hub[CaseStudiesHub]
  hub --> flagship[layout_flagship]
  hub --> efficiency[layout_efficiency]
  hub --> creative[layout_creative]
  hub --> launch[layout_launch]
  hub --> expansion[layout_expansion]
  flagship --> kpi[KPI_strip]
  efficiency --> beforeAfter[BeforeAfter_metrics]
  creative --> gallery[Visual_gallery]
  launch --> timeline[Launch_timeline]
  expansion --> markets[Markets_chips]
```

| `layout` | Use when | Signature UI |
|----------|----------|--------------|
| `flagship` | GoSports / deep PPC+AM | Full metric hero, 4+ KPIs, long solution, optional Vimeo |
| `efficiency` | ACoS/PPC recovery (e.g. VoltTech) | Before → after comparison band |
| `creative` | Listing / visual / CVR (e.g. case-study-4, 7) | Image gallery / A+ proof slots |
| `launch` | Units / first 30 days (case-study-2) | Timeline + unit KPI |
| `expansion` | EU / catalog / 7-figure brand (6, 8) | Market chips + multi-metric grid |

Shared on all details: breadcrumb, challenge, results, related studies (same `serviceFilter` or `category`), case-specific CTA (“Discuss similar [category] results”).

**EVIDENCE:** Competitor pages above; EG JSON inventory; schema/template files cited.

**RISK:** Layout chrome without rewriting soft studies looks fake. Mitigate: ship hub + **flagship (case-study-9)** first; upgrade other bodies before enabling premium variants; never invent metrics.

**VALIDATION:** Playwright hub filters + featured; each layout slug smoke; URL inventory unchanged; SITE-SEO-MAP + VERIFICATION-LOG.

---

## Content quality bar (non-negotiable)

- Only metrics already in JSON / live site / approved case pages — mark Assumed if upgrading.
- Named brands vs anonymized: keep honesty (AgentsUp-style label when anonymized).
- Fill `quote` only when real; otherwise omit section.
- Fix GoSports challenge mid-sentence (“stagnant due to:”) before flagship ship.
- Rewrite the 8 templated solution blocks over phases — do not fake uniqueness.

---

## Schema / architecture changes (planned)

Extend [`case-study.schema.ts`](src/domain/content/schemas/case-study.schema.ts) with:
- `layout`: enum above
- `featured`: boolean (hub)
- `timeframe`, `vertical` / strengthen `category`
- `servicesDelivered: string[]`
- `gallery?: { src, alt }[]` (creative)
- `beforeAfter?: { label, before, after }[]` (efficiency)
- `timeline?: { label, detail }[]` (launch)
- `relatedSlugs?: string[]` or compute from filter
- Keep `href` / `slug` / canonical as today

Renderer: thin switch in detail template → layout modules under `src/components/case-studies/layouts/`.

---

## Phased delivery

1. **Research doc** — write findings to `docs/research/CASE-STUDIES-ENTERPRISE-AUDIT.md` + link from COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.
2. **Hub redesign** — PO chrome, featured, filters, metric cards, CTA.
3. **Schema + layout flagship** — case-study-9 only as reference implementation.
4. **Remaining layouts** — assign each of 1–8 a layout; enrich content study-by-study.
5. **Align homepage strip** to same card visual language (optional same PR if small).
6. **Verify + staging deploy** after APPROVE.

---

## Out of scope for v1

- Changing URLs to `/case-studies/gosports/` (would need redirect program + approval).

# Case studies: enterprise presentation

## Scope

Rebuild both the hub (`/case-studies/`) and detail templates, driven by extended JSON in [content/config/case-studies.json](content/config/case-studies.json). Preserve paths `/case-studies/` and `/case-study-1/` through `/case-study-9/`. Research and plan first; implement only after APPROVE.

Key files today:
- Hub: [src/app/(marketing)/case-studies/page.tsx](src/app/(marketing)/case-studies/page.tsx), [case-studies-grid.tsx](src/components/case-studies/case-studies-grid.tsx), [case-study-card.tsx](src/components/case-studies/case-study-card.tsx)
- Detail: [case-study-detail-template.tsx](src/components/case-studies/case-study-detail-template.tsx)
- Schema: [case-study.schema.ts](src/domain/content/schemas/case-study.schema.ts)

## Current state (Verified)

- 9 studies; service filter pills; 3-column cards.
- One linear detail layout: Hero, Challenge, Solution steps, Results cards, optional Quote, blog CTA.
- Quote field unused; 8 of 9 share identical 3-step solution copy; only GoSports (case-study-9) is narrative-grade.
- Hub/detail visuals softer than Project One hard-chrome on homepage/services.
- Homepage case strip uses a separate data path from the hub.

## Competitor research (Observed 2026-10-15)

- Canopy case studies: outcome-first cards (+579%, $722K, TACoS), trust density. Do not invent portfolio-scale stats.
- AgentsUp: vertical/market chips, Brand withheld honesty, KPI block before story.
- Sellexio: Challenge, Approach, Numbers with service tags.
- Mazescale: category-named stories with result bullets above the fold.
- B2B pattern: outcome title, proof block with timeframe, anchors, quote, story-matched CTA.

EG fit (from [docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md](docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md)): boutique premium proof mechanics, not fake enterprise scale.

## Counsel

Treat case studies as a proof product. Hub is a scannable KPI gallery. Detail uses a layout variant by engagement type. Content depth must match the chrome.

Hub plan:
- PO hard-chrome hero
- Featured strip for GoSports (and later featured true)
- Keep service filters; add category chips when data exists
- Metric-forward cards with real image alts
- Free Audit CTA (not blog CTA)

Detail layouts via a `layout` field:

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  hub[CaseStudiesHub]
  hub --> flagship[layout_flagship]
  hub --> efficiency[layout_efficiency]
  hub --> creative[layout_creative]
  hub --> launch[layout_launch]
  hub --> expansion[layout_expansion]
```

- flagship: GoSports / deep PPC+AM — metric hero, 4+ KPIs, long solution, optional owned Vimeo
- efficiency: ACoS/PPC recovery — before/after metric band
- creative: listing/visual/CVR — gallery slots
- launch: first-30-days units — timeline + unit KPI
- expansion: EU/catalog/7-figure — market chips + multi-metric grid

Shared on all details: breadcrumb, challenge, results, related studies, category-specific CTA.

Risk: premium chrome on soft templated bodies looks fake. Ship hub + flagship GoSports first; rewrite other bodies before enabling premium variants. Never invent metrics.

## Schema changes

Extend case-study schema with: layout enum, featured, timeframe, servicesDelivered[], gallery[], beforeAfter[], timeline[], relatedSlugs (or computed). Keep slug/href/canonical unchanged.

Renderer: switch in detail template to modules under `src/components/case-studies/layouts/`.

## Content bar

- Only verified metrics from JSON/live/approved sources
- Honest anonymized labels where brand is withheld
- Quote only when real
- Fix GoSports challenge mid-sentence before flagship ship
- Rewrite the 8 templated solution blocks over phases

## Phases

1. Write `docs/research/CASE-STUDIES-ENTERPRISE-AUDIT.md` and link from competitive research
2. Rebuild hub: featured, filters, PO metric cards, CTA
3. Schema + layout modules; ship flagship on case-study-9
4. Assign layouts to case-study-1..8; enrich content study-by-study
5. Align homepage strip visual language if low-cost
6. Playwright URL/SEO checks, VERIFICATION-LOG, staging deploy on APPROVE

## Out of scope for v1

- Semantic URL renames without approved 301 map
- Fake logos or invented TACoS/ROAS

| KPI-first cards | Strong | Strong | Strong | Strong | Strong | Weak |
| Timeframe on card | Medium | Weak | Medium | Strong | Present in meta | Missing |
| Named vs withheld honesty | Strong | Named | Mixed | Named | Named | Often anonymized |
| Before/after pairs | Strong | Medium | Medium | Strong | Strong | Only GoSports deep |
| Unique method per study | Strong | Strong | Strong | Strong | Strong | Weak (templated) |
| Separate SEO detail URLs | Anchor | Yes | Yes | Long page | Yes | Yes (keep) |

## Problem (Verified)

Case studies now feel rich. Service pages feel dry even though JSON already declares 3–4 modules each.

All 15 services have `differ`, so **comparisonTable never renders**. Process and checklist never render. Thin pages (catalog, trademark, company reg, sourcing, Shopify, email) often show **only one** `proofGallery` image.

Recipe intent already exists in [`docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md`](docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md) but is blocked by the filter.

arguments.plan:
# Service body sections visual redesign

## Research verdict (Observed / Verified)

Staging bodies (catalog, PPC) still feel flat after the niche-visuals pass because **mid-page media improved** while **core body grammar did not**.

Monotony arc in [`service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx):

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  problem[Problem FitMatrix]
  audience[Audience FitMatrix]
  solution[Solution Spine]
  deliverables[Deliverables Spec]
  differ[Differ Contrast]
  stats[Stats late]
  modules[Modules]
  problem --> audience --> solution --> deliverables --> differ --> stats --> modules
```

| Section | Current pattern | Why it feels weak |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------|
| Problem | 2-col Fit Matrix, text `01` labels | Flat cells, no hard per-item panels |
| Audience | **Same** Fit Matrix again | Highest monotony — twin of Problem |
| Solution | Vertical spine, `max-w-2xl` prose | Sparse vs case-study 2-col strategy cards |
| Deliverables | Spec sheet + accent bar | OK — keep |
| Differ | Dark contrast matrix | OK — keep |
| Stats | After Differ | Too late; early body stays prose-only |
| Modules process/checklist | Hard panels | Echo Solution / Deliverables |

Case-study contrast (port patterns, not copy): numbered badge rails, per-item hard panels, early CredentialsBar, StrategyStages 2-col, BeforeAfterBand — [`case-study-modules.tsx`](src/components/case-studies/layouts/case-study-modules.tsx).

## Locked approach

Layout/chrome pass only. No SEO copy rewrite. No URL changes. Keep lead form + Differ + Deliverables structure.

1. **Move stats early** — render [`ServiceStatsStrip`](src/components/services/service-stats-strip.tsx) immediately after hero (before Problem), matching case-study CredentialsBar placement.
2. **Problem → Issue rails** — replace Fit Matrix with numbered hard-panel tiles (case-study `KeyIssuesList` chrome): filled `01` badge, title, description; 2-col grid of separate panels.
3. **Audience → Fit strip** — different layout: horizontal/compact row of hard chips or single-row accent cards (not a second Fit Matrix). Distinct from Problem at a glance.
4. **Solution → Stage cards** — replace airy spine with 2-col hard panels + step number badge + title/body (case-study `StrategyStages` without inventing outcome chips unless JSON already has them).
5. **Deliverables + Differ** — keep Spec sheet and Contrast Board; minor spacing polish only.
6. **Module processSteps** — keep numbered rails but force horizontal 4-col hard chips with shorter visual weight so they do not read as a second Solution.
7. **Results** — keep 2-col cards; bump metric lockup already shipped; no new images.

## Key files

- [`src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx) — section order + Problem/Audience/Solution markup
- [`src/components/services/service-stats-strip.tsx`](src/components/services/service-stats-strip.tsx) — early placement
- [`src/components/services/modules/service-modules.tsx`](src/components/services/modules/service-modules.tsx) — processSteps density tweak
- Reuse [`caseStudyHardPanel`](src/components/case-studies/case-study-hard-panel.ts) / [`serviceHardPanel`](src/components/services/service-hard-panel.ts)

## Implementation phases

1. Stats early + Problem issue rails + Audience fit strip
2. Solution stage cards
3. Process module polish; spacing pass on Deliverables/Differ
4. Staging deploy; Playwright spot-check catalog + PPC + listing body H2 order and section heights

## Success criteria

- Problem and Audience no longer share the same matrix chrome
- Solution reads as dense cards, not a thin spine
- Stats visible before Problem
- Body scroll feels varied (rail → strip → cards → spec → contrast → media)
- No invented metrics or copy rewrites

## Out of scope

- Full SEO rewrite per service
- New diagram generation
- Changing module recipes / JSON content beyond what layout needs

# Service body sections visual redesign

## Research verdict (Pass 1 + Pass 2)

Staging bodies still feel flat because **mid-page media improved** while **core body grammar did not**.

### Pass 2 smoking gun (Verified — staging catalog)

| Section | Height | Shell pattern |
|---------|-------:|---------------|
| Problem | **516px** | 1 matrix shell, 1 grid |
| Audience | **516px** | **Identical** matrix shell + muted band |
| Solution | 601px | Vertical spine (4 circle nodes) |
| Deliverables | 614px | Spec sheet |
| Differ | 511px | Dark contrast matrix |
| Stats | 238px | Late grey strip |

Problem and Audience are layout clones at the same pixel height — that is why the body feels repetitive before media modules appear.

### Case-study body contrast (Verified — `/case-study-1/`)

| Section | Height | Hard panels |
|---------|-------:|------------:|
| Credentials (early) | 169px | 1 |
| Challenge | 409px | **4** separate panels |
| Approach | 924px | **5** stage panels |
| Before/after | 543px | 4 |
| Results | 486px | 6 |

Case studies vary panel count and section height; services repeat one Fit Matrix twice.

### Competitor body patterns (Observed — pattern only)

| Source | Body rhythm to steal |
|--------|----------------------|
| AMZ Dudes account mgmt | Early trust line; checkmark “who for” lists; numbered `01–08` capability rails; Day1→Week2 timeline |
| Canopy PPC | Early KPI strip; icon capability grids; 3-phase Control/Dominate/Expand |
| Live EG `/services-2/` | Long WP prose + icon cards — **do not copy** (low density) |

### Monotony arc

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  problem[Problem FitMatrix]
  audience[Audience twin]
  solution[Solution Spine]
  deliverables[Deliverables Spec]
  differ[Differ Contrast]
  stats[Stats late]
  modules[Modules]
  problem --> audience --> solution --> deliverables --> differ --> stats --> modules
```

## Locked approach

Layout/chrome pass only. No SEO copy rewrite. No URL changes. Keep lead form + Differ + Deliverables structure.

1. **Move stats early** — [`ServiceStatsStrip`](src/components/services/service-stats-strip.tsx) immediately after hero (before Problem), like case-study CredentialsBar and Canopy KPI strip.
2. **Problem → Issue rails** — separate numbered hard panels (filled `01` badge), 2-col gap grid — case-study `KeyIssuesList` chrome. Break the single Fit Matrix shell.
3. **Audience → compact who-for strip** — AMZ Dudes checklist cue: 2-col compact hard rows or chip list with check accents — **must not** reuse Fit Matrix cell borders. Target height distinctly lower than Problem (~280–360px band).
4. **Solution → Stage cards** — 2-col hard panels + step badge + title/body (case-study `StrategyStages` / AMZ Dudes `01–08` rails). Drop airy single-column spine.
5. **Deliverables + Differ** — keep Spec sheet and Contrast Board; tighten SectionShell rhythm only.
6. **Module processSteps** — horizontal 4-col hard chips with shorter copy weight so they do not read as a second Solution.
7. **Results** — keep 2-col metric cards (already densified).

## Key files

- [`src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx)
- [`src/components/services/service-stats-strip.tsx`](src/components/services/service-stats-strip.tsx)
- [`src/components/services/modules/service-modules.tsx`](src/components/services/modules/service-modules.tsx)
- Reuse [`serviceHardPanel`](src/components/services/service-hard-panel.ts) / case-study badge patterns

## Implementation phases

1. Stats early + Problem issue rails + Audience compact strip
2. Solution stage cards
3. Process module polish; Deliverables/Differ spacing
4. Staging deploy; Playwright: Problem height ≠ Audience height; different chrome classes

## Success criteria

- Problem and Audience no longer share Fit Matrix chrome or matching heights
- Solution reads as dense stage cards
- Stats visible before Problem
- Body scroll: credentials → issue rails → who-for strip → stage cards → spec → contrast → media
- No invented metrics or copy rewrites

## Out of scope

- Full SEO rewrite per service
- New diagram generation
- Fake awards / logo walls
- Changing module JSON recipes beyond layout needs

# Per-service graphics and infographics density

## Verdict (Verified)

Body copy redesign shipped; the remaining dryness is **module graphics**, not section chrome.

| Tier | Slugs | Module graphics today |
|------|-------|------------------------|
| Dry (1 diagram) | catalog, trademark, company-reg, sourcing, shopify, email | 1x `infographicSpotlight` only |
| Mid | DSP (browser only); PPC + reporting (browser + chart); full-service (browser) | No teaching spotlight |
| Rich | listing, video, content, visual, TikTok | spotlight and/or multi-item gallery |

Module hard cap remains [`.slice(0, 4)`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx). Dry pages already use spotlight + process + checklist (3/4), so one more module fits.

Staging check: catalog spotlight still renders ~280–350px tall foreground inside blur+contain—diagrams feel small even when present.

## Approach (committed)

1. **Fix spotlight presentation** so one diagram reads as a real infographic.
2. **Wave A — six dry pages:** add a **second full-width `infographicSpotlight`** (not a 33vw gallery stamp).
3. **Wave B — mid paid/ops:** add **one** teaching spotlight each (PPC, reporting, DSP, full-service).
4. **Wave C — rich pages:** no new art required; only wire unused on-disk assets where a gallery slot is empty or weak (content/listing already strong).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  fix[ContainedMedia spotlight mode]
  waveA[Wave A: 6 second spotlights]
  waveB[Wave B: 4 mid spotlights]
  verify[Staging Playwright per slug]
  fix --> waveA --> waveB --> verify
```

---

## 1. Spotlight render fix

Files: [`contained-media.tsx`](src/components/services/modules/contained-media.tsx), [`infographic-spotlight.tsx`](src/components/services/modules/infographic-spotlight.tsx)

- Add a `variant="spotlight"` (or equivalent prop): **no blur twin**, solid panel background, `object-contain`, enforce `min-h-[280/420/480px]` so the diagram fills the frame.
- Keep gallery stamps on `variant="gallery"` (4/3 blur+contain unchanged).
- Goal: catalog-style pages show a readable full-width teaching surface, not a small JPG floating in a blurred crop.

---

## 2. Wave A — second infographic per dry service

Generate one new niche JPG per slug under `public/images/services/{slug}/`, log provenance in [`docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md`](docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md). Captions stay conceptual / not legal advice / not Seller Central UI.

| Slug | Keep (spotlight 1) | Add (spotlight 2) | Module order after |
|------|--------------------|-------------------|--------------------|
| [`amazon-catalog-management`](content/config/services/amazon-catalog-management.json) | `catalog-health-system.jpg` | **ASIN defect lanes:** suppressed / stranded / variation break / attribute gap → remediation | spotlight, spotlight2, process, checklist |
| [`amazon-trademark-brand-registry`](content/config/services/amazon-trademark-brand-registry.json) | `brand-registry-flow.jpg` | **Registry unlocks matrix:** mark status → Brand Registry capabilities (A+, SB, Brand Analytics)—illustrative | same |
| [`amazon-company-registration`](content/config/services/amazon-company-registration.json) | `company-registration-flow.jpg` | **Verification gates swimlane:** entity → tax ID → bank → Amazon identity checks—not legal advice | same |
| [`amazon-product-sourcing`](content/config/services/amazon-product-sourcing.json) | `product-sourcing-flow.jpg` | **Spec → sample → QC → PO → FBA prep** funnel | same |
| [`shopify-website-development`](content/config/services/shopify-website-development.json) | `shopify-amazon-stack.jpg` | **Amazon PDP ↔ Shopify DTC sync** (inventory / pricing / content)—illustrative | same |
| [`email-retention-marketing`](content/config/services/email-retention-marketing.json) | `email-retention-lifecycle.jpg` | **Owned lifecycle map:** welcome → replenish → win-back (no WhatsApp chat crops) | same |

Art direction: same hard-panel agency look as existing `*-flow.jpg` / `catalog-health-system.jpg` (flat diagrams, brand colors, no emoji, no fake UI chrome claiming live Seller Central).

JSON: insert second module `{ "type": "infographicSpotlight", "id": "service-infographic-spotlight-2", ... }` immediately after the first spotlight.

---

## 3. Wave B — mid-tier teaching diagrams

These pages have proof crops but no structure diagram. Add **one** `infographicSpotlight` each (fits under module cap).

| Slug | New diagram | Placement |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| [`amazon-ppc-management-agency`](content/config/services/amazon-ppc-management-agency.json) | Sponsored Products / Brands / Display roles + ACOS feedback loop | After `browserProof`, before `metricChart` → browser, spotlight, chart (+ drop nothing; currently 2 modules) |
| [`amazon-reporting-analytics`](content/config/services/amazon-reporting-analytics.json) | Metric stack: traffic → conversion → profit (what gets reviewed weekly) | After browser, before chart; if at 4 with checklist, keep browser + spotlight + chart + checklist (drop duplicate process if present) |
| [`amazon-dsp-management`](content/config/services/amazon-dsp-management.json) | Upper-funnel DSP vs lower-funnel Sponsored Ads layers | After browserProof |
| [`full-service-amazon-agency`](content/config/services/full-service-amazon-agency.json) | Pod coverage map: catalog / PPC / content / creative / reporting | After browserProof |

Do **not** reuse `wa-*.avif` on email/TikTok. Growth sales AVIFs stay on paid/reporting only.

---

## 4. Wave C — rich pages (no new generates)

| Slug | Action |
|------|--------|
| visual, listing, video, content, TikTok | Leave module sets; verify staging galleries still load |
| catalog only | Optionally set `hero.atmosphere` to keep `catalog-management-v2.png`; unused `amazon-catalog-management-service.jpg` stays unused (atmosphere already strong)—do not force a third surface |

---

## 5. Docs and verification

- Update [`docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md`](docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md), [`docs/ai/CHAT-SUMMARIES.md`](docs/ai/CHAT-SUMMARIES.md), [`docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md`](docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md)
- Append recipe note in [`docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md`](docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md): dry ops pages require **two** spotlights
- Staging deploy; Playwright per slug: count full-width spotlights ≥2 on Wave A; ≥1 teaching spotlight on Wave B; ContainedMedia has no blur twin on spotlight
- Visual spot-check: catalog, trademark, shopify, PPC, DSP

## Out of scope

- Body section redesign (already shipped)
- New schema module types
- Raising the 4-module cap
- Fake Seller Central or Amazon Ads UI screenshots

## Success criteria

- Six dry services: **2** full-width niche infographics each
- Four mid services: **1** new teaching infographic each
- Spotlight diagrams readable at ≥420px min-height (sm+) without blur double-image
- Rich creative pages unchanged in structure
- Professional captions; no decorative Unicode/emoji in art or copy

    return {
        'id': cfg['id'],
        'type': 'infographicSpotlight',
        'heading': cfg['heading'],
        'subheading': cfg['subheading'],
        'image': {
            'src': cfg['src'],
            'alt': cfg['alt'],
            'caption': cfg['caption'],
        },
    }

    path = ROOT / f'{slug}.json'
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    modules = data.get('modules') or []
    # skip if already present
    if any(m.get('id') == cfg['id'] for m in modules):
        print('skip existing', slug)
        continue
    # insert after first spotlight
    new = []
    inserted = False
    for m in modules:
        new.append(m)
        if m.get('type') == 'infographicSpotlight' and not inserted:
            new.append(make_spotlight(cfg))
            inserted = True
    if not inserted:
        new.insert(0, make_spotlight(cfg))
    data['modules'] = new
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('waveA', slug, 'modules', len(new), [m['type'] for m in new])

for slug, cfg in WAVE_B.items():

    if any(m.get('type') == 'infographicSpotlight' for m in modules):

        continue
    spotlight = make_spotlight(cfg)
    new = []
    inserted = False
    after = cfg.get('insert_after')
    for m in modules:
        new.append(m)
        if after and m.get('type') == after and not inserted:
            new.append(spotlight)
            inserted = True
    if not inserted:
        new.insert(0, spotlight)
    # cap at 4 if somehow over (shouldn't)
    data['modules'] = new[:4]
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('waveB', slug, 'modules', len(data['modules']), [m['type'] for m in data['modules']])

# Catalog Management — unique page (Service 1 only)

## Diagnosis (Verified)

Staging [`/amazon-catalog-management/`](https://ecom-gliders.vercel.app/amazon-catalog-management/) uses the same shell as every service via [`service-page-template.tsx`](src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx):

Hero → generic agency stats → **The problem** (4 cards) → **Who it is for** (4 cards) → **How we work** (4 cards) → 2 JPG spotlights → **What you get** (8 cards) → **Why us** (4 cards) → process steps → checklist → Proof → FAQ

That is why it feels like “dabbay ke baad dabbay” and AI template copy. Kickers and card grids are shared UI, not catalog-specific composition.

Live site: `https://ecomgliders.com/amazon-catalog-management/` returns **404** (Observed Playwright). Real-site catalog signal comes from case studies + related blogs (listing errors / suppressed listings), not a dedicated WP page. Verified proof we can use: Kitchen **73%** (`/case-study-1/`), FocusForm **7-figure / multi-ASIN** (`/case-study-8/`). Agency-wide `$112M+ / 95%` strip is not catalog-specific — remove from this page.

Competitors (CaptenAMZ, GrowithAmazon, Qubeq): lead with **error taxonomy + fix route + verify**, big ASIN/fix-time claims, problem tables. We will **not** copy their “24h fix” claims. Our wedge: revenue-first remediation + ads/content coordination + named case proof in browser frames.

## Direction (locked for this plan)

**Browser-led Catalog Ops page** — Catalog opts out of the shared Problem/Audience/Solution/Deliverables/Differ card stack. Other 14 services stay on the current template until their own counsel pass.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  hero[Hero_catalog_specific]
  browser[BrowserProof_health_board]
  lanes[Issue_Fix_Verify_lanes]
  chart[MetricChart_case_proof]
  oneDiagram[One_spotlight_max]
  slim[Slim_scope_list]
  results[Results_linked]
  faq[FAQ_CTA]
  hero --> browser --> lanes --> chart --> oneDiagram --> slim --> results --> faq
```

## New Catalog section order

<dynamic_tools>
You have access to tools through dynamic namespaces, e.g. MCP servers, using `GetDynamicTools` and `CallDynamicTool`.

## Dynamic Tool Discovery and Invocation

Use `GetDynamicTools` to discover tool schemas, then `CallDynamicTool` to invoke one tool. Aim to minimize round-trips: ideally one discovery call followed by one invocation.

If the user mentions a product or service represented by an available namespace, and the request likely depends on it, proactively inspect that namespace before answering. If you are unsure which namespace matches, search with a relevant pattern.

`GetDynamicTools` supports these modes:

1. `{"namespace":"<id>"}`: returns schemas and full descriptions for every tool in that namespace.
2. `{"namespace":"<id>","toolName":"<name>"}`: returns one tool schema with its full description.
3. `{"pattern":"<regex>"}`: searches namespace and tool names.
4. `{"namespace":"<id>","pattern":"<regex>"}`: searches tools within one namespace.
